sanskrit: duḥkhitāḥ kānaneṣvadridarīṣvantarguhāsu ca ūṣurdīrghatamaḥ kālaṃ kvaciddaityairvilakṣitāḥ evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇāmatītaṃ dvisahasrakam praṇamya taṃ prāha śakraḥ baddhā'ñjalipuṭastadā cirāya paridṛṣṭo'si śiṣye mayi dayāṃ kuru purā vidhiḥ prārthito'pi mayā bhūyaḥ svayaṃ jagau pratīkṣa kālaṃ kālena vinā no sidhyatīhitam na taṃ kālaṃ prapaśyāmi leśato'pi sukhāvaham eṣa kuñjaḥ kaṇṭakitaḥ svargo nandanameva ca vandinaḥ karaṭā ete śālūrāḥ stutivācanāḥ upadhānaṃ gulmapādo mantrā'hvānaṃ śivādhvaniḥ cāmarāḥ kaṇṭakitaruśākhā vātyāpravepitāḥ nūnaṃ bhāgyaṃ mamaivaitadityuktvā mūrcchito'bhavat samāśvāsyā'marapatiḥ provācā'ṅgiraso vacaḥ āpatsu harṣakalitāḥ sampatsu samatāṃ gatāḥ śokaṃ jitvā vimarśena sandhairyeṇa mahājanāḥ śṛṇu te'trā'bhidhāsyāmi vyavasāyaṃ phalāvaham na yonijairmānasairvā mṛtyustasya śiveritaḥ devādyaiḥ puruṣaiścā'pi nā'sya mṛtyurudīritaḥ prayāhi śaraṇaṃ nā'sti rakṣako'nyaḥ kathañcana dhyātamātro jagatprāṇaḥ praṇamya samupasthitaḥ tvaṃ sarvadāgatiḥ sarvaprāṇaścā'pi mahābalaḥ śīghramanyān surān sarvān pāvakapramukhānapi tatra pauruṣayogena sādhyaṃ sarvasamīhitam sametā himavacchṛṅge śakrādyāḥ sarvato'marāḥ

niścitya bhaṇḍadaityasya vijayāya samīhitam evaṃ vidhimukhā devāstripurāṃ parameśvarīm evaṃ teṣāmagāddhyānaniṣṭhānāṃ vatsaraṃ śatam mahāyāgena tripurāmayajan tantramārgataḥ yatra brahmā'bhavadbrahmā ācāryo gurureva ca prāpte'ntyadivase tasmiṃścidbhāvapravibhāvite ayajat pūrṇayā'hutyā gururdhyāyan parāmbikām prādurāsit kuṇḍamadhyāccidagnerjvalato'ntarāt yojanaikasamucchrāyā jvālā'tyantaṃ vyavardhata śatā'śaninipātātmā bhindaṃcchrotrāṇi nākinām sakṛt sudāminīkoṭisaṅghaṭṭasadṛśacchaviḥ mahatā dhvaninā tadvattejasā ca budhāstadā vinā guruṃ trimūrtibhyaḥ patitāḥ sarva eva te taruṇā'ruṇapuñjā'ṅgasampradāyatanucchaviḥ vidyullatāvikasitāpūrṇacandrā'mbujā'nanā tārakājālavadvyomakavarīratnabhūṣaṇā sindūrā'ruṇalohityā'kṣiptakeśanabho'ṅgaṇā kuntalā'ligaṇā'kīrṇavikasadvadanā'mbujā kandarpakoṭijananamantrā'kūtasamīkṣaṇā cāmpeyakalikāsampatprapoṣakasunāsikā apāṅgasaridunmajjattāṭaṅkamaṇinīrajā karṇabhūṣākānticāpakaṭākṣaśarasantatiḥ vikasadraktakumudā'ntarakiñjalkadacchaviḥ mandahaṃsakṣīranidhipravālaradanacchadā maṇigraiveyakākalpalasadgīvā'bjasundarā

māṇikyadehalatikāstanastavakaśobhinī mandasmitasaritpūrakhelatkucamarālikā karapravālā'grajapākorakā'ṅgulimaṇḍitā valayā'ṅgadaratnormikūrpāsavilasadbhujā romā'litanunālodyatkucadvandvā'bjakuḍmalā nābhisaronnītaromalatāśaivālavallikā ūrdhvā'ṅgadhāraṇāmātranimittaprāptamadhyamā māṇikyakadalīkāṇḍapāribhāvyūrumaṇḍalā kamaṭhīpṛṣṭhavibhavasūcanaprapadā'nvitā vikasatpadmasaubhāgyavadānyapadapaṅkajā nakhacandrasudhāsyandahṛtasannatataptatā bhaktavāñchāvitaraṇapadamandārapallavā daṇḍavat praṇatā bhūtvā jaya devīti tāṃ jaguḥ paśyaṃstaddarśanodbhūtaharṣavāridhisamplutaḥ netrā'mbujasravaddharṣavāripūrapariplutaḥ racanācāturīmodairmodayaṃstripurāmbikām hāniḥ kṣīrasindhorivā'nyau pūrvavanmāyayaiva hi dhanyāḥ dhanyā jayanti yogīndrapūjyāḥ guṇabhūtā vidhimukhā api tuṣṭuvurambikām sarvā'bhāsanatanurapi vitatā saṃvidanuttaramātraśarīrā vijayatyetattava durghaṭanāghaṭanāśaktirmahatī sattā

kṛtvā darśanadṛśyavibhedān vidhidhān sarvān paribhāsayasi bandhkaṃ citparimṛṣyā'ntaryatnādbhūyo bhāsi yathāvat dṛṣṭvā kalpitametatsvīyaṃ nandasyaniśaṃ devi ! namaste sa ca lokānāṃ tvamiva maheśvari ! līlādraṣṭā nandati devaḥ teṣāmetatparamaṃ rūpaṃ prakaṭitamakṣṇoḥ phalasaṃjananam sṛṇiśaracāpān pāśaṃ bibhradvayamiha bhūyaḥ praṇamāmastat atha tān prāha paramā vatsā uttiṣṭhata drutam kiṃ vo'bhilaṣitaṃ bhūyaḥ pratīcchadhvaṃ guṇeśvarāḥ niśamyaivaṃ vaco devyāḥ procurbrahmādayastata. bhagavatīlalitā'virbhāvavarṇanaṃ nāmaikapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ prāhurbrahmamukhā devīṃ bhaktinamrasumūrtayaḥ vidheyamamarā'rīṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ pravihiṃsanam nūnaṃ trilocanenā'sau sarvato'maratāṃ gataḥ śrutvaivaṃ dhātṛmukhyānāṃ vacaḥ sā prāha śaṅkarī mā'haṃ yonisamudbhūtā manasā vā'pi kasyacit aprasiddhena cā'streṇa nihanmyenaṃ mahāsuram athovācā'maraguruḥ parāśaktiṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ paśyantu śakrapramukhā bhūyāsustena pāvitāḥ śṛṇu jīvaśakramukhā naivaṃ śaktimayīṃ tanum na hi sādhāraṇaḥ kaścidevaṃrūpāṃ prapaśyati ato vo darśitaṃ caitannānyairdṛṣṭaṃ kadācana atha bhūyo'pi bahudhā prārthayāmāsa tāṃ guruḥ yadi māmīdṛśīṃ śakraḥ paśyettacchṛṇu vacmi te darśayiṣyāmi tasmai svamidaṃ rūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ antardhānaṃ yayau tatra brahmādīnāṃ prapaśyatām

śrutvā śrītripurādevyā āvirbhāvaṃ tato vṛṣā lakṣmīsūktavidhānena bhaktiśradhā'tinirbharaḥ evaṃ tasyā'rādhayato māsāḥ ṣaṭ pañca cā'tyayuḥ bhaṇḍāsurāya tadvṛttaṃ jñāpayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ sāmprataṃ paramāṃ śaktimupatiṣṭhati bhaktitaḥ dhvaṃsayiṣyati dāvāgnistṛṇadārucayaṃ yathā nā'tropāsyo dṛśyate'nyaḥ sāmno balavadāśrite indrāya pātālamātrarājyastāṃ jagadīśvarīm ityuktvā pūjitastena jagāmā'bhimatāṃ gatim mantrayāmāsa daityo'sau sevitaḥ śūnyake pure kaścit sāma bhedamanyaḥ parodānamuvācaha tadantare viśukrasya putraḥ śukrasamo mataḥ śṛṇu rājannarthaśāstramaryādāsahitaṃ vacaḥ dṛṣṭyā buddhyākhyayā sattvarūpayā vimṛśet kṛtim suvimṛśyakaro yastu taṃ sampat pravṛṇotyalam rājā'himatavaktā ca satataṃ svārthatatparaḥ yathā naurāsanacchidrā sapānthaṃ nāvikaṃ jale śṛṇvahaṃ te'bhidhāsyāmi kartavyā'nantarakriyām aprāptamabhayaṃ strībhyo matvā'lpamiti te mudhā rājyaṃ tribhuvane prāpya striyā vinihato balī hatau yuddhe caṇḍikayā sabalāviti naḥ śrutam anyacca te'bhidhāsyāmi cirametaddhi saṃsthitam taṃ tamuddharate viṣṇurmārgasthamiva kaṇṭakam toṣitā paramāśaktirāvirbhūtā vadhāya te amānasā yonijebhyo nā'maratvaṃ tvayā vṛtam

sa yadāha na cā'lpaṃ tadvidhi daityagaṇeśvara ! manīṣiṇā sarvayatnairnirasyaṃ kālajaṃ bhayam sarvathā mūlanāśo hi śaktyā'pohyaḥ prajānatā atra me'bhimataṃ rājan śṛṇu buddhyā vicāritam tapasā pūrvavaddevān śeṣaṃ bhayamapohya ca iti te'bhihito mantro nā'taḥ kṣemaṃ bhavet kvacit śrutavarmavacaḥ śrutvā bhaṇḍo daityapatirvacaḥ martukāmasyā'gadavanna tattasya hyarocata daityeśvara mayā proktaṃ śṛṇvatrā'tisukhāvaham eṣa bālastava bhujabalaṃ no vetti kiñcana rājñāṃ yuddhaprasaṅgeṣu kā viprasya bhavenmatiḥ nimantraṇavidhānajñāsteṣāṃ yuddheṣu kā gatiḥ na khaḍgadhārāṃ jānanti na śūrāḥ śarasaṃstṛtau grāmasiṃhabibhīṣitaistadebhā mūtramutsṛjuḥ tarhi mattebhakumbhasya vipāṭo jambukaiḥ kṛtaḥ yoṣidvā puruṣo vāpi nopekṣyaḥ śatrutāṃ gataḥ vijeṣyati pratāpā'rkasantāpitajagattrayam kuśāgrairapi viddhaḥ syāllohaśailo nirantaraḥ māmā'jñāpaya te bhṛtyaṃ gatvā'haṃ tānnimeṣataḥ śrutvaivaṃ daityavacanaṃ prahṛṣṭo bhaṇḍadānavaḥ vatsa ! kiṃ yuddhavārtābhireva bhīto'si vai mudhā yaḥ striyo yuddhavārtābhireva bhīto napuṃsakaḥ dhiṅmāṃ yastvādṛśaṃ cakre mantriṇaṃ mantranāśakam ityuktvā protthitaḥ khaḍgahasto devān vihiṃsitum yatra śakramukhā devāstripurāṃ samupasthitāḥ

atyantabhītā deveśīmuccaḥ pāhīti saṃjaguḥ gaccha jvālāmālini tvaṃ rakṣa bhītān surān drutam jvālayā tān rurodhoccairjvālāmālinikā śivā hatān devān praharṣeṇa bhaṇḍadaityaḥ punaryayau vitrastā martukāmāste chittvā'ṅgāni samantataḥ aśeṣā'ṅgāni hutvaivaṃ pūrṇāhutitayā tanum tadantare sā tripurā bhaktarakṣāparāyaṇā jātaścaṭacaṭāśabdaḥ kuṇḍamadhyānmahonnataḥ jvālāmadhye mahādevīṃ sarvasaundaryasantatim athotthāya śakramukhāstuṣṭuvustāṃ maheśvarīm puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūdvyomno nedurdundubhayo'pi ca brahmādyāḥ sarvatastasyāḥ pūjāṃ cakruryathāvidhi vividhairbhakṣyabhojyādyairāsavaiḥ piśitairapi gāyanairnṛtyavādyārdyairutsavairapi bhūriśaḥ dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ vidhātṛmukhyānūcuste devyāḥ saṃsthānahetave praṇamya prārthayāmāsuryattacchṛṇu ghaṭodbhava ! asyāṃ jagatyāṃ yannityaṃ paśyāmastvāṃ maheśvarīm prāpya tvadīyaṃ te lokaṃ paśyāmastvatpadāmbujam brahmāṇḍabhedaṃ nā'rhanti tattvāṃ draṣṭumabhīpsavaḥ prārthitetthaṃ brahmamukhaistripurāmbā maheśvarī avasat saparīvārā yathā loke svake tathā kāmeśvaraṃ patiṃ cakre samūḍhā'bhavadambikā papraccha vibhavaśrutyāṃ parāyāṃ jātakautukaḥ kīdṛśaṃ kiṃ pramāṇañca yasmin vasati sā parā

jñātavānnāma kiṃ tasya saṃsthānañcā'pi kīdṛśam ārādhitā sā tripurā prasannā'bhavadambikā kiṃ māhātmyaṃ bhavet sūktametanme vaktumarhasi itthaṃ paryanuyuktaḥ sa hayāsyo munisattamaḥ śṛṇu kumbhaja vakṣyāmi bhaktiśradhāyuto hyasi vaktumarhaṃ sarvathaiva dhanyo'si tvaṃ mahītale etasya kāraṇaṃ vedmi naitadalpaphalaṃ mune ! tripurāpādabhaktistu durlabhā sarvato bhavet śivaviṣṇvādibhaktistu dvāaramatra prakīrtitam mucyate sarvathā janturnānyathā kalpakoṭibhiḥ loke sāmrājyayuktasya ye'nugāstāratamyataḥ anirodhaṃ svoparisthaprāptau mārgaṃ diśanti ca prāṅgaṇeśaprāptimāpa diśatyeva ghaṭodbhava ! mukhyagauṇaprabhedaśca yathā deheṣu vai śiraḥ ye ca pādabhavā devāḥ sadā sevanatatparāḥ etat saṅgasya māhātmyamaho bhāgyamaho tapaḥ yatte priyā satī lopāmudrā'khyā rājakanyakā taddhetuṃ te pravakṣyāmi na tajjānāti kaścana tatsevanaparo rājā sarvadā sarvabhāvataḥ piturdṛṣṭvopāsanāyāḥ kramaṃ devyā yathākramam evaṃ cirā'rādhanena bhaktyā bhāvanayā'pi ca vavre cā'sau sarvajagatpūjyāyāḥ pādasevanam lakṣitā cā'pi tāṃ vidyāṃ vāksamudrapariplutām vidyā ṛṣitvaṃ samprāptā tannāmnā sā sphuṭaṅgatā iti śrutvā kumbhabhavaḥ patnyā vibhavavistaram

athā'vadaddhayāsyo'pi prasannaḥ kumbhajanmane śrīsūktasya vidhānaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ paramapāvanam vidyevaitadgopitavyaṃ sarvatrā'tisugopitam purā śriyā sudṛṣṭaṃ tadvedā'bdheḥ samyaguddhṛtam samprāptā lokamātṛtvaṃ sarvapūjyatvamāgatā prasannā chandayāmāsa vareṇa tripurā parā vatse ! tvayā vinā viṣṇuraprabhuḥ paripālane tato me niyaterbhaṅga eva nā'rhasi samprati dhārayāmi svarūpañca tatte vakṣyāmi śrūyatām śrīcakraṃ me bhaveccakraṃ śrīkramaḥ syānmama kramaḥ mahālakṣmītyahaṃ khyātā tvattādātmyena saṃsthitā yadyattava priyaṃ loke tanmamā'pi priyaṃ bhavet tatrā'hamapi pūjyā syāṃ bhaktairapi viśeṣataḥ hutā'pi vividhairdravyaiḥ prasannā vāñchitā'rthadā sarvakāmapradā yantre mūrtyādike'pi vā lakṣmīsūktaṃ ṣoḍaśarcaṃ devyāḥ snānavidhau paṭhet pūjā'śaktau kevalaṃ vā sūktante yaḥ paṭhet sadā vidyā'pi tvatsamāyogādbhaviṣyati mama priyā pūrṇā tena samādiṣṭā mahāśrīṣoḍaśākṣarī sā pūjā syānmahāpūjā prasannā'haṃ tato drutam pūrṇarūpā prārthitā'haṃ ṛṣibhiḥ pāvakāt pituḥ tvamahaṃ devyahaṃ tvañca nāvayorantaraṃ bhavet iti dattvā varaṃ tasyai ramāyai tripurā parā śrīsūktasya mahitvaṃ tenaitadbrūyāḥ kathañcana atha vakṣye śrīpurasya vṛttaṃ lokottaraṃ śṛṇu

yadā sā paramā devī prārthitā vidhimukhyakaiḥ aṅgīcakāra saṃsthānaṃ līlāvigrahadhāriṇī ājñāpayadvidhirdevyāḥ śrīpurasya vinirmitau bhagavanna mayā jñātaṃ tatpuraṃ kutra saṃsthitam etanme śaṃsa bhagavan vidhāsye'haṃ niśamya tat śrīpurasya pramāṇañca saṃsthānaṃ prakṛtiṃ tathā yadcchrutvā tripurāpādabhaktimāsādayecchubhām tasya madhye mahāśṛṅgo yaścatu'śatayojanaḥ śrutvā mayā yathāproktaṃ kartvyaṃ suvidhānataḥ yathā jagatpratiṛtistanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu śrīcakrasaṃsthānavidhivaraṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ūrdhvato'nantasaṅkhyākaḥ sudhāsindhurjagatkute tasya madhye manidvīpaḥ prabhākṣiptatamastatiḥ kalpadrumavanaiścitraiścitritā paritaḥ sthalī yojanānāṃ caturlakṣairdīrghāyamasuvistṛtam caturasraḥ sarvabhadraḥ samujjvalitadiktaṭaḥ caturdhāryuto bāhye parikheṇa virājitaḥ prākāraḥ kāṃsyaracitaḥ proktamāno'tibhāsuraḥ daśayojanavistīrṇavāpīśatavirājite dikṣvaṣṭasu yutesvarvāyasmayārdhabahirbhuvi (???) kamalā'karā'ntarbhuvi kḷptakāṃsyagṛhāṣṭake "śatayojanavistārasamunnamre suśobhite tripurāmbāpādasevāprāptasaubhāgyanirbharaḥ asaṃkhyaparivāraighaiḥ sevitaḥ satataṃsthitaḥ prākārastāmraracitastaruṇā'ruṇasamprabhaḥ

bahirantaḥ kāṃsyatāmramayasthalayutā'ntaraḥ gṛheṣu rājate teṣu vasantartuḥ supeśalaḥ saṃyutaḥ svaparīvāraiḥ samedhate nijaśriyā proktarītyaiva vijñeyā viśeṣaḥ procyate kramāt grīṣmartuḥ saṃsthitaḥ śukraśuciśaktiparīvṛtaḥ nabhonabhasyaśaktibhyāṃ varṣartustatra śobhate śaradṛturiṣorjā (?) bhyāṃ śaktibhyāṃ tatra rājate sahassahasyaśaktibhyāṃ himantastatra rājate kadambavipinaṃ tatra hālā'modasumeduram kīramaṇḍalacāṭūktimadhuradhvanisundaram saṅgītamāṭṛkā devī mātaṅgītyabhiviśrutā vīṇāveṇumukhā tadvacchyāmalā laghupūrvikā śrīmātṛkā tatpriyā'nyā (i?) cetyevamaṣṭadiksthitāḥ atha vapraḥ puṣparāgamayaḥ pūrvoktavat sthitaḥ padmarāgamayo vaprastadanto'gniśikhā'ruṇaḥ sālo gomedamaṇijastatra bhairavanāyakaiḥ karālā kālameghābhā karavālakṛtā'yudhā dvātriśatkoṭibaṭukayutaḥ saṃsevitā sadā tato vajramayaḥ sālastatra vajrā nadī sthitā taṭābhyāṃ gaomedavajramayābhyāṃ pravibhāsinī vajrapradānasantuṣṭā vajripramukhapūjitā nirantara. dhyāyamānāḥ parāmbāpādapaṅkajam muktāvaprastadantasthā dikpālā dikṣu vai kramāt tāladrusyandadatyantahālāsaurabhasambhūtaḥ aparādhijanān daṇḍeyojayantī susaṃsthitā

tato vidrumasālaḥ syādvaprāttatrā'ntare sthitaḥ navaratnakṛto vaprastato'tiruciraḥ śubhaḥ tato'pyanekaratnaughamayo vapro'tibhāsuraḥ tato manomayaḥ sālo'ruṇoruṇasamacchaviḥ praphullapadmasaṅkīrṇā tryaṃśemadhyabhuvaḥ sthitā tanmadhye navaratnāḍhyanaukāyāṃ suvirājite asaṃkhyaratnapotasthaśaktibhiḥ parivāritā atha budhimayaḥ sālo viśadaścandravimbavat tatra'mṛteśī taraṇisaṃsthānā śaktibhirvṭā ājñāṃvinā'mṛteśānyā nainat pibati kaścana ahaṅkāramayastasmādvaraṇaḥ śyāmalā'kṛtiḥ mimarśā'khyā jñānarasavahaniścalaśitalā tadājñāmantarā tatra naiṣat prāpnotī tadrasam tyajanti tāpaṃ pa"yanti jagattattvamanāvṛtam tatrā'ntare samāsīnaḥ sūryo jalajaviṣṭare tatra somaḥ sthito rājā kiraṃstatra sudhāṃ'śubhiḥ kaustubhā'khyamaṇibrātanirmito rucirā'kṛtiḥ tatra kaustubhasaṅkḷptapote śṛṅgāranāmake anekakoṭikandarapiratiprītigaṇairapi tatpāre tu mahāpadmavanamāmodameduram karṇikāścāpi cā'tyantadīrghāstatte bravīmyaham viṃśatiryojanānāntu patrā'yāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ yojanānāṃ pañcadaśa kesarāṇāñca dīrghatā tatra bhṛṅgāmaṇinibhāḥ śailaśṛṅgamitāḥ sthitāḥ cintāmaṇipravekā'tiracitaṃ citracitritam

tāvadvijñāyā'bhimataṃ mahātripurasundarī tā visṛṣṭāḥ sthite sthānaṃ mahātripurasundarīm ityuktvā tapa evaoccaiścakruḥ prāk śaktibhiḥ saha avalokanato jātāḥ śaktyo vedasaṅkhyakāḥ dṛṣṭvā śaktigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ tapasyabhirataṃ sadā bhūyo dadarśa parito jātaṃ śakticatuṣṭayam triṇetrāśca tapasyeva ratā dṛṣṭvā ca pūrvajāḥ dadhānā aṅkuśañcāpi raktavarṇavibhūṣaṇāḥ pāśābhayavarasṛṇidharaśca tapa āsthitāḥ tapasyeva ratāstāśca dṛṣṭvā śaktīḥ puraḥ sthitāḥ nityāṃ ṣoḍaśikāṃ vatse varaṃ brūhyabhivāñchitam prāptā ca parayā tatra sāyujyaṃ ṣoḍaśī parā svayantu pañcamī bhūtvā tāsāṃ tuṣṭā samāsthitā ratneśvarītvamādyānāṃ kāmadhuktvaṃ tataḥ param lakṣmīśvarītvamantyānāṃ śaktivṛndā'sane sthitim ratnāḥ kāmadaghāḥ kalpalatākośā'bhidhāyutāḥ pañcaviṃśatisāhasrasaṃkhyāstāstu pṛthakpṛthak pañcasāhasra sasaṃkhyākā mūladevyāstu śaktyaḥ tṛtīyā bhuvaneśānī turyā vārāhikā matā sudhāpīṭheśarī cā'dyā sudhāsūśca tataḥ parā atha kalpalatāstatra pañcakāmā tataḥ parā pañcabāṇeśvarī cā'tha paraṃjyotistataḥ parā iti kośeśvarīḥ praoktāḥ śṛṇu lakṣmīśvarīstataḥ sāmrājyalakṣmīśca ramā ceti pañcakadevatāḥ dadau samīpasaṃsthānaṃ binducakropari kramāt

mātaṅginyāśca vārāhyā dadāvatulasampadam vārāhyā daṇḍinītvañcaca duṣṭadaṇḍanehatutām madhyaṃ sthānaṃ dadau devī prasannā parisevanāt kāmeśvarī ca vajreśī bhagamālinikā ca yā vāme ca dakṣiṇe pārśve sthānaṃ devyabhikalpayat sā prāpa tapasotkarṣādvajrasālā'ntare bhūvi vajratneśvarītvañca tena vajreśvarī matā prāpustapasa ādhikyāttathā kāmeśvarī punaḥ tathā'nyā api śaktistu mahātripurasundarī evaṃ navasu cakreṣu vibhatya vinive ya ca tripurā tripureśī ca tathā tripurasundarī tripuramālinī tripurā siddhā tripurā'mbikā tattadāvaraṇā'dyā'gre sthitā tatsadṛśā'kṛtiḥ tathā brahmādibhirdṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ śaktigaṇā'vṛtam kāmeśa bhagavan deva tvamapi sṛja svāṃ'śataḥ manyāmahe śaktimahe śaktigaṇaṃ kevalaṃ viṣamantviti ubhayāṃ'śāttadanyasmādasṛjadvedasaṅkhyakān pustakā'bhītiaraciddadhānān sphaṭikaprabhān padmā'sanasamāsīnān prasannavadanekṣaṇān pṛthagvidyāgurun yūyaṃ sṛjadhvamiti cā'bravīt tṛtīyo mānavā'khyāṃstu gaṇānasṛjata kramāt nāthānnavā'sṛjatturyaḥ kālamūrtīnmahāprabhān taptvā prāpa sthānamapi tvaritā pṛṣṭhabhāgake divyasiddhamānavaughaguruṇāṃ saṃsthitāni hi pūrṇopāsanayogenopāsya śāstroktamārgataḥ

iti te pṛṣṭamākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mahat saptapañcāśattmo'dhyāḥ jagadvidhe! tvāṃ pṛcchāmi guravastvaugharupiṇaḥ nāma teṣāñca sarveṣāmathā'gneḥ kuṇḍamīritam tatra kuṇḍe bhavadbhiśca strīrūpā kena hetunā na tṛpyāmyadbhutakathāṃ saṃśṛṇvannapi bhūriśaḥ pibannapi ciraṃ daivahataṃ sthāṇumṛte kvacit śrutvā viśvakrtoktaṃ tat prasannaḥ prapitāmahaḥ pārvatīṃ sarvato guptāṃ prasannaḥ prabruve tava vāgvidyāguravaḥ sarve svacchasaṃvittirupiṇaḥ caturvidhā śabdamayī parāśaktirvijṛmbhate tripurākhyā hi yā śaktiḥ svacchasaṃvedanāmayī sarvāstisārabhūtā'tmarūpī parameśvarī sarvā'śrayacitiḥ svacchā kevalā vāgagocarā tadeva sarvasvātantryamato māyākhyamīritam svayaṃ svātmānamamalaṃ vikalpayati bhūriśaḥ vikalpa eva śabdātmā sthūlamadhyavibhedataḥ tatra sthūlantu yadrūpaṃ vaikharīti prakīrtitam tallaukika'laukikatvādvidhā sarvatra saṃsthitaḥ ṣaḍjarṣabhau ca gāndhāramadhyapañcamadhaivatāḥ rāgā'bhdibhūtā'gnidasranāgasaṃkhyāvibhedinaḥ tadetaddevasaṃsthānaṃ guravaḥ saptasaṅkhyakā vyaktastvalaukiko vidyāmayaḥ kūṭacatuṣṭam siddhaughaguravaḥ proktāḥ ṣaṣṭhīśapratibhāvitāḥ tatsaṃśrayā mānavāḥ syuratastā vasusaṃkhyakāḥ

auḍḍīśaprabhavā ete vasusaṃkhyāstu mānavāḥ dhvanirāśiḥ samāyukto varaṇarāśyaṣṭakena ca kālasyā'vachedakāste turīyapadasaṃśrayāḥ satyaḥ pūrṇaḥ svabhāvā'khyaḥ pratibhaḥ subhagā'bhidhaḥ oghaścaturvidho vidyāvibhedādyugabhedataḥ oghastu pañcamo'pi syādguruvidyāpravartakaḥ vayaṃ divyabhāvāḥ siddhāḥ kumārādyāśca mānavāḥ athā'gneścinmayatvaṃ te varṇayāmi kramācchṛṇu tamaḥ kriyaḥ sattvamūrtirvikasaścinmayā'ntaraḥ dakṣavāmamadhyasaṃsthaṃ paiṅgaleḍāsuṣumṇakam baddhaṃ madhyaṃ jñānamārgaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ rāhurāryakāḥ kriyāmicchāṃ cetayati martyāstena hi cetanāḥ āśrayībhūtacinmātrasyordhvavāhaśca cetanāḥ na cetayanti te bhūtaṃ bhavyañca kvacidātmani evaṃ sthite mahādevo yastrinetrastato'dhikaḥ tenā'ntarasmadvijñānaṃ pūrṇaṃ samupalakṣyate phāladeśe vinirbhinna madhyanāḍī cidātmikā tasmāttannetrasambhūtaścidagniriti viśrutaḥ śṛṇu loke viśvakarman yatsukhaṃ taccidātmakam sukhāvahaṃ sundarañcaloke pratyakṣabhāvanāt svavaibhavātmakaṃ viśvaṃ svātantryeṇa prakāśitam abhimāno vṛthā mohādahaṃ kartetisaṃsthitaḥ tathā'pyasammataprāptirbhavedvā kathamīraya tasmādyoṣinmayadhyānaṃ tayaiva pravibhāvitam evaṃ sthitā mahārājñī cintāmaṇigṛhe tadā

matvā tadapi no samyaṅmahādevaḥ sadāśivḥ brahmāṇḍeṣu sthitā devā daityā martyādayo'pi ye te tatra tattatsthāneṣu nivasanti pṛthak pṛthak tattadvaprāntarabhuvi svāmyaṃ prāpya sunirmalam viśanti paramaṃ bhāvamavāṅmanasagocaram pūrvaṃ saṃsthitasāyujyaṃ labdhvā tiṣṭhanti sarvataḥ brahmāṇḍāntarasamprāptāḥ ṣaṣṭisāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ mānaṃ śrīpurasaṃsthitam yatra śrīpurasāmrājñī tripurāmbā bhaviṣyati iti dhātṛvacaḥ śrutvā viśvakarmā'tiviṣmitaḥ vibhāvayan vidhiproktaṃ harṣanirbharitā'taraḥ nāmā'ṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ kumbhodbhavaḥ prāha bhūyastatkathāśravaṇotsukaḥ tapovighnaṃ nirjarāṇāṃ cikīrṣan vahninā'vṛtān tataḥ kimakarottatra tanme vada suvistaram punaḥ śrotuṃ samīhā me vardhate'titarāṃ nanu śṛṇu kumbhodbhava kathāṃ vicitrāṃ paramā'dbhutām śūnyakaṃ pratyājagāma śaradabhrmivā'mbarāt dadarśa vṛṣṭameghābhaṃ vādayan vallakīṃ śubhām sampūjya vidhinā prāha kṛtāñjaliridaṃ ca kṛpayā paśya śiṣyaṃ te durlabhaṃ te kṛpekṣaṇam prāyo viprā bhīravo hi gururme bhayamohitaḥ devāḥ śaktimupāsīnāḥ prasannā yadi sā bhavet ityukto'haṃ daityagaṇaistatrā'yāto jighāṃsayā hṛṣṭaḥ pratyāgataḥ sthānaṃ tatra pṛcchāmi prastutam

kaścittatra vimukto vā tanme śaṃsamunīśvara daityeśvarebhyo'sūyā me na kartavyā kadācana prabhāṣase kathaṃ mugdha iva tvaṃ paṇḍito'pi san śokasthāne harṣayuto yatastvaṃ vīkṣito mayā āvirbhūtā tvadvadhāya toṣitā śakramukhyakaiḥ sarvalokeśvarī divyarūpā'dabhutamahābalā sameṣyati tvāṃ nihantuṃ kiṃ tuṣyasi hi mūḍhavat nūnaṃ mayā puraivoktaṃ viprāḥ prakṛtibhīravaḥ viṣṇuḥ sureṣvatibalī sa yuddheme parājitaḥ devāsurādisraṣṭā'haṃ lokaśastrā'strasantateḥ kathaṃ bhīto'si strīgetornisargādabalāḥ striyaḥ devarṣimānayamāsuravarodhe sakhīgaṇaiḥ pādyā'rghyaiḥ subalidravyaiḥ praṇamya prāhurādarāt vayamasmānnirīkṣasva dṛṣṭyā karuṇayā bhṛśam utpannā lalitā devī devaiḥ samabhipūjitā tadbodhyā'surapatiṃ yathā nāśaṃ na caiṣyati uddharā'smān duḥkhasindhoḥ pāhi naḥ paricārikāḥ vīkṣya tāsāṃ praruditaṃ karuṇā'krāntamānasaḥ daityeśvara ! maduktaṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu vākyaṃ sudhāsamam hitavaktā hi lokdeṣu janaḥ paramadurlabhaḥ vadettamabhijānīyācchatruṃ mitrasvarupiṇam kaṭukaṃ hyauṣadhasamaṃ jānīyānmitrameva tam taduktamatyantapathyaṃ rogiṇo bheṣjaṃ yathā tadahaṃ prabravīmi tvāṃ yattaddaityapate śṛṇu tatrā'pi śṛṇu vakṣyāmi kaiṭabho daityaśekharaḥ

viṣṇunā nihato yuddhe'pratimo balaprauruṣe to'nayaiva parayā mahāsurabalairvṛtaḥ na kiṃ smarasi gauryā te yuddhe pūrvaparābhavam sevyate yā'nekakoṭigaurīpramukhaśaktibhiḥ yasya prasādādeva tvaṃ manyase balināṃ varam tadalaṃ svā'tmasarvārthanāśanā'bhiniveśataḥ ahaṃ tvāṃ tatra neṣyāmi parāśakteḥ padāntikam rājyaṃ prasādhi pātāle divaṃ śāsatu vāsavaḥ na kariṣyasi matproktaṃ yadā yahi vinaṅkṣyasi dhiyā sāttvikayā caitadvimṛśa svātmarakṣaṇam hastenā'dāya devarṣiṃ prārohat saudhaśekharam vātāyane maṇimaye viveśa mṛduviṣṭare devarṣamayi roṣaṃ tvaṃ na śiṣye kartumarhasi yadbravīṣyakhilaṃ tatte nā'nyathā viditaṃ mayā jānāsi sarvaṃ me vṛttaṃ līlayaivaṃ bravīṣi mām kadācit sā toṣaṇāya tripurāyā mahattapaḥ kadācit kinnarī kācittāruṇyā'mṛtapūritā sroto'bhiruhyamānā sā trātāraṃ nā'dhigacchata tāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ samāropya taṭamāruhya sattvaram tadaṅgasparśanāścāhaṃ lāvaṇyasya samīkṣaṇāt kalyāṇi tvaṃ rakṣitā'si mayā mṛtyormukhādivā kṛte pratikṛtīṃ kuryācchaktaḥ sarvātmanā svayam tanmāṃ kāmāgninā'viṣṭamārtaṃ te śaraṇā'gatam śrutvā madviparītoktiṃ sādhvī sā kinnarī vacaḥ mā buddhibhraṃśamāgaccha kinnarī patidevatā

āste tasya priyā cā'smi tarucchāyeva saṅgatā ya āpadbhyaḥ samuddhartā yaśca bālyaprapoṣakaḥ tvaṃ te sutā dharmato'haṃ naivaṃ māṃ vaktumarhasi nāśayettaṃ manaḥ śīghraṃ mano yasya vaśe na hi strīsukhaṃ sarvato hyekaṃ na viśeṣaḥ paśuṣvapi patibratānāṃ krodhāgniṃ prāpya mā bhasmatāṃ vrajāḥ kāmamohaparītā'tmā parāmrṣṭumupadruta vadantī rakṣa rakṣeti tatastasyāstu sammukhe athaṣṭvā'nayaṃ devī ramā kruddhā śaśāpa mām kṛtyaṃ tavā'suraṃ hye tattatastvamasuro bhava pratibuddhaḥ śokasindhunimagno'bhavamañjasā punaḥ prāha ramādevī māṃ magnaṃ śokasāgare śariraṃ te ghorarūpaṃ paradārā'bhimarśanam evaṃ tayā praśapto'haṃ bhīto devīśriyaṃ tadā evaṃ cireṇa bhūyo'pi prasannā'bhavadambikā māṇikyaśekhara ! kṛtaṃ tvyā'tyantavininditam nā'nyathā me bhavecchāpaḥ kṛtaṃ bhoktavyameva te kintu tāṃ patitāṃ toye dayayoddhṛtavānasi prāpyā'nekā'ṇḍanāthatvaṃ bhuktā bhogāna yathepsitān prāpya tatra ciraṃ kālamasuraiḥ pratipūjitaḥ śrutvaitadvacanaṃ bhūyo hyapṛcchaṃ lokamātaram sā kiṃ tvatto'dhikā devī nā'haṃ jāne tavā'dhikām ityāpṛṣtā mayā devī prāha śrīlokamātṛkā mahācitisvarūpā sā yasyāḥ prakṛtidharmataḥ īśavaro'pitirodhānakarastriguṇajeśvaraḥ

yasyā īkṣaṇaleśenā'nugrahādakhilaṃ sṛjet anugrahānmocayituṃ sṛjatyeṣa maheśvaraḥ dehabhāvaṃ samāpannā sṛṣṭau jñātuṃ prabhāvitaḥ sarvā'tmarūpā paramā citiśaktirudīritā sarvā'tmanā vṛṃhaṇena brahmaśabdena śabditā avāṅmanasagamyā sā cetyanirmuktacinmayī dve kale tasya nāthasya kāryatā kartṛteti ca indriyāṇāntu daśakaṃ bhūtānāṃ pañcakaṃ tathā kartṛtā syāt saptadaśī kalā nityā maheśituḥ tāṃ hitvā na śivaḥkaścit brahmā vā'pi sadāśivaḥ nara nāryaḥ prāṇijātaṃ jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ tathā bhūṣaṇeṣu svaraṇamiva jalavat sāgarādiṣu tejasyuṣṇaṃ yathā rūpaṃ jalespandoraso yathā sā svā'bhāsitalīlā'tmalokoddharaṇahetunā jātā vayaṃ tadaṅgebhyo vākśrīgaurīsamāhvyāḥ vacanāttu tathā jātā tārā bhairavasaṃyutā krauryāt pratyaṅgirodbhūtā mahāśarabhasaṃyutā caṇḍikā caṇḍaśabdena dhūmrā krūrekṣaṇena ca tasyā līlā'vatāreṇa lalitā'khyena saṅgare ityuktastu tayā paścāt prārthanaṃ kṛtavān punaḥ āsuratvaṃ bhavedyonisambandhena vinā mama na jātu māmiyaṃ prajñā jahātu jagadambike ! tadahaṃ bhaktamūrdhanyāt kāmā'ṅgājjanimāptavān viṣayānuttamān bhuktvā nityañca cirakālataḥ vastuṃ tasyāḥ samīpe'haṃ talloke kṛtaniścayaḥ

pratīkṣāmi kadā'gatya vidhiṣyati ca māmiti talloke nivasāmyāśu iti me tvarte manaḥ iti śrutvā bhaṇḍavaco nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ jagāmā'bhimataṃ sthānaṃ nārado munisattamaḥ kṛpāvaśāddevīdhāmaprāptivarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ prasannaḥ prāha saṃhṛṣtaḥ svā'nubhūtanirūpaṇāt mānasaṃ bāhyamapi ca mamā'sīdyat purātanam cirakālenā'ntaritamapyadyeva tavoktitaḥ yatparākṛpayā sarvaṃ viditaṃ bhāhyamāntaram atītamāntaraṃ bhāhyaṃ kathate viditaṃ hyabhūt śrutvetthaṃ nāradavacaḥ prahasya hāritāyanaḥ atropapattirapare khaṇde samyagbhaviṣyati vareṇa brahmaṇaḥ sarvabāhyaṃ vā'pyāntaraṃ tathā saṃsmarāmyavidagdhaṃnu śrīdevyāḥ suprasādataḥ śṛṇu bhārgava ! tatpaścāddhāyā'syaḥ kumbhajanmane śṛṇukumbhodbhava mune homā'gnijanitāṃ śivām dṛṣṭvā śakramukhā devāścintayāmāsurāntare latevā'lambarahitā bhartṛhīnā na śaobhate dadhyuḥ kāmeśvaraṃ yāvattāvatso'pi vinirgataḥ dṛṣṭvā'nurūpa devyāste patirasyā varo mataḥ tadvijñāya vidhimukhāḥ prārthya devīṃ parātparām atha devaiḥ prārthitā sā lalitā parameśvarī samastā'varaṇaughāṃśca smaraṇāt samavā'sṛjat praṇamya daṇḍavaddevīṃ stutvā vividhasaṃstavaiḥ devyahaṃ samanuprāpto bhaṇḍadaityasya sannidhe

tadahaṃ preṣitastena tvāmāhā'surabhūpatiḥ ajñātvā madbalaṃ mugdhā vināśaṃ mā vrajā'dhunā bhūyaḥ parājitānmatto māyāmātrasamāśritān dveyāt sukhaṃ mṛtyumukhapraviṣṭamiva sarvathā manye'haṃ tvaṃ jitaprāyā tena dhīreṇa sāmpratam niśamya nāradoktiṃ tāṃ mantriṇīṃ samavekṣata kareṇā'dāya devarṣi rahasi prāviśat parā pṛccha nārada ! praṣṭavyaṃ yatte manasi vidyate nūnaṃ nā'viditaṃ te'sti loke śrīpādasaṃśrayāt ājñapta evaṃ mantriṇyā praṇamya suratāpasaḥ devī! bhaṇḍāsuro dṛṣṭo mayā samyak parīkṣitaḥ kathaṃ yuddhe parābhūyāt parāpādaikasaṃśrayaḥ ciraṃ nivasya śrīloke tato gacchāmi tatpadam vayaṃkasmāllokagatiṃ vindāmastadubravīhi me śṛṇu me nārda ! vaco rahasyamapi sāmpratam tasyottamapadaprāptiḥ sarvathā syānna cā'nyathā na yacchati tathā pathyamauṣadhaṃ hyanapekṣitam taṃ bhaktaśekharaṃ hatvā duṣkṛtaṃ vitataṃ kṛtam svapadaṃ prāpayatyāśu tathā śṛṇu bravīmyaham tasmai tattripurā śighraṃ prayachati na saṃśayaḥ tāvadeva tasya ciraṃ tataḥ sveṣṭamavāpnuyāt ajñasya tatsamīhā syāt jñasya vai tatkuto bhavet tṛptaḥ kathaṃ bhuktimicchettava'nyo bhojayet katham ākāśasyeva pūrṇasya kiṃ prāptiḥ syāt kathaṃvada ? śrūtvetthaṃ nāarado mantriṇīproktaṃ hṛṣṭamanasaḥ

atha sā tripurā devī bhaṇḍā'suravadhaṃ prati cakrarājasamakārarathe parvanavā'tmake ūrdhvabhūmau sthitā yuddhasambhāraughasusambhṛtā śastrā'stranicayopetā roṣā'ruṇitalocanā śastrāṇyastrāṇi ca tathā mūrtimanti sthitāni vai deśitāścitrakavacaiḥ śastrā'straiḥsupariṣkṛtāḥ taddkṣiṇe tu mantreśī saptaparvavirājite śukādiśyāmalāvargaiḥ sevyamānā viniryayau tathāvidhā'saṅkhyakoṭimātaṅgatanayā'vṛtā mantriṇī toṣayantyastā vilāsairhāsyamiśritaiḥ tasyā mano'nukūleṣu mantreṣu niyataṃsthitā atha tadvāmato daṇṇdasāmrājñī śūkarā'nanā parivṛtā hyanekābhirjambhinyādisvaśaktibhiḥ aparādhaparān sarvān daṇḍayantī sadā sthitā sthitābhyāṃ sīramusalamukhaśastraiśca śobhinīm tathā śrīlalitādeśyā bālā tripurasundarī nijāvṛttimahāśaktigaṇaiḥ parisamāvṛtā raṇakolāhalā'khyāne tridhā bhinne'tibhīṣaṇe nisargamatte saṃruḍhā mahāṅkuśavidhāriṇī vindhyodbhavā malayajāḥ prāgjyotiṣasamudbhavāḥ praceluḥ sampadīśitrīparīvārasuśaktibhiḥ tasyā śritā vāmabhāgamaśvāruḍhā maheśvarī gandharvajātijaṃ vāyujavanaṃ samadhiṣṭhitā "śuktyardhaśuktimaṇibhirdevasvastikapadmakaiḥ sūkṣmā'vadhānato'pyasya na viduḥ khurasaṅgatim

tāmanvaśvā asaṃkhyeyāḥ sindhuṭaṅkaṇambhavāḥ śoṇāḥ śyāmāḥ sitāḥ pītāḥ kapilāḥ pāṭalāstathā vicitrāścārusarvāṅgā ghanakesaramaṇḍanāḥ vicitraśastrā'stradharaśaktibhiḥ samādhiṣṭhitāḥ dārayanto'vanimiva khurakṣepairviniryayuḥ dveṣitasvanasaṅghātairgajacītkāramiśritaiḥ jayabheraīravairmṛṇḍḍmṛdaṅgajhallarīravaiḥ miśritaḥ śrīcakrarājarathanemigaṇodbhavaḥ śrūtvā śrīlalitādevyā yaitrayātrāmahāsvanam bhaṇḍadaityaḥ svātmavadhaṃ cirābhilaṣitaṃ tayā atha daityān samālokya trastān śuṣyanmukhāmabujān nūnaṃ hīme mama kṛte vinaśyanti sabāndhavāḥ matkṛte nihatānetān śociṣyanti priyātmajāḥ tadahaṃ purato gatvā yuddhvā śrīlalitāmbayā śocayāmi kutastvetā viyojya svasvabāndhavaiḥ śakto'rakṣan svīyajanaṃ śokasthānāt kathañcana athaivaṃ mayi nirtya prāpte devyā nijā'tyayam kathaṃ mayi hate devatrāsanā mama bāndhavā bhaviṣyanti śucā hīnā na caitadapi sammatam nūnāṃ mayi hate devyā bhrātṛputrādibāndhavaḥ yudhā'gnau svātmaśalabhān bhasmīkuryurna saṃśayaḥ devā iva dainyabhājo viyutāḥ strīsutādibhiḥ ārodanantu bandhūnā nāastīti na kathañcana ādau devyā hateṣveṣu tato'hamabhavaṃhataḥ pāvanaṃdevatāśastraiḥ prāptirlokottamasya ca

atrā'pi manye strībālamukhānāṃ n hi sambhavam atha vaitanmayā pūrvaṃ śrutamabjāsanānmukhāt iti tanme parīvāraṃ na śoṣayatu sā parā jānānasyā'pi me devī mohamutpādayatyalam tattaṃ sarveṇa bhāvena śaraṇaṃ prāptavānaham pāhi māṃ parameśāni śaraṇye ! śaraṇāgatam iti prārthya mahādevīṃ tripurāṃ bhaṇḍadānavaḥ harṣayanniti hovāca parākramayutaṃ vacaḥ na me mṛyuḥ kuto'pyasti mṛtyormṛtyurahaṃ yatha sacarā'caralokānāṃ sraṣṭā'haṃ vaḥ samakṣataḥ tatremāmabalāṃ jñātvā na śīghraṃ hantumutshe svā'ntaḥ puraṃ samānīya mahā'nandamuṣaimyalam bhaṇṇdāsurasyohāmapohavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ babhāṣe krodhatāmrākṣo rathaḥ saṃyujyatāmiti nivedayaddaityanāthe praṇamyā'tivinītavat gṛhītvā saśaraṃ cāpaṃ pracacālā'tiroṣitaḥ daityā viniryayuḥ śīghraṃ sannaddhāḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ niryayurdaityasubhaṭāḥ saṅghaśo dhṛtahetayaḥ kuṭilākṣo'grajasteṣāmameyabalavikramaḥ akṣauhiṇīśatayutā bhaṇḍadaityā'grato yayuḥ pārśvayordaityparājasya viṣaṅgaśca viśukrakaḥ rathasthau tau mahācāpau krudhā'ruṇitalocanau pratyekamakṣauhiṇīnāṃ śatena parivāritau anujagmurdaityapariṃ śatā'kṣauhiṇisaṃyutāḥ rarāja rājapathyā tu prāvṛṭkālanadī yathā

turaṅgabhaṅgā dviradagrāhā kheṭakakacchapī khaḍgadīrghamahāsarpā tūṇimatsyavicitritā vicitracchatrahaṃsādipatatritatimālinī rathaghoṣamahāghoṣā vāhiṇī jalavāhinī kulyāmukhājjalaṃ hyāśu kedāre prasṛtaṃ yathā tadantre tu vijayaḥ prāpya daityeśvaraṃ drutam prāpyā'jñāmavadattaṃ suvacastatkālasammatam pratāpatapanaścordhve brahmāṇḍāni tapatyasau so'pi tvatsammukhaṃ prāpya yudde bhūyaḥ parājitaḥ tathā'pi mantriṇā kāle cār'thaśāstrapramāṇataḥ kāle yuktamanuktvā tu na sumantritvamarhati tatraikiao'pi sve kāle sammato balavattaraḥ naśyedasadṛśaṃ bhuktvā hyāmayīvā'gadaṃ nṛpaḥ dṛṣṭvā yuddhaṃ tena śreyaḥsamāpnuyāt tāvat senā'pi sannddhā bhaviṣyatyaviśaṅkitā vijñaptavyamidaṃ kāle mayā te svāminaḥ puraḥ niśamya mantrivākyaṃ tadyuktaṃ kuśalasammatam niveśya senāpatibhiḥ senāṃ tatra vibhāgaśaḥ amitraghnaṃ mantrivaryaṃ prāha bhaṇḍamahā'suraḥ nā'haṃ tvāṃ sundarīṃ devīṃ sarvathā saṃśrayocitām yuddhaśraddhā taveyaṃ vai sammtaṃ mama sarvathā kintvahaṃ tvāṃ priyākārāṃ dṛṣṭvā drutaṃ manobhavām sāmnā yuddhena vā'pi tvāṃ karomyātmasamāśrayām vimṛśyaitaddrutataraṃ pakṣamekataraṃ bhaja balañcasarvaṃ tatkṛtyaṃ jñatvāa yāhi druta punaḥ

vidyunmālinmahāprājña māyāvikulanāyaka balañca vyavasāyañca bhedacchidrāṇi yuktitaḥ ājñaptāvitarau daityau yayatuḥ śaktivāhinīm amitraghno mahāsenāṃ viveśā'bdhiṃ yathā plavaḥ praviṣṭamātraṃ śaktyā sa gṛhīto balavattaraḥ capeṭayā nihatyā'śu gṛhītvā taṃ gale'suram kastvaṃ senāmimāṃ devyā daṇḍarājñīsurakṣitām ājñāṃ vinā daṇḍarājñyāḥ praviṣṭo vāhinīmimām tadantare tu samprāptāḥ sainyarakṣāniyojitāḥ prabalābhiḥ samākṛṣṭo nihato mūrcchito'bhavat samakṣaṃ hyānayāmāsa svaparīcāraśaktibhiḥ vijñāpya mantriṇī devyāḥ samīpamānayattataḥ nītvā papraccha dūtaṃ taṃ kṛtyaṃ tatrā'gamasya hi dūto'haṃ tasya daityasya taduktaṃ saṃbravīmyaham yuddhvāvā'pyayuddhvāvā vā devi bhūyāstvaṃ matsamāśrayā taddevān samparityajya bhava tvaṃ matsamāśrayā ityahaṃ preṣitastena dūtabadhyā [dhaḥ] vininditā [naḥ] iti matvā praviṣṭo'haṃ lakṣaitaḥ sarvaśaktibhiḥ ānītaste samakṣañcetyetat sarvaṃ nirupitam niśamya dūtavacanaṃ lalitāyā mataṃ tataḥ mābhairdaitya vraja sukhaṃ hanyase na kadācana yadi te jīvane śraddhā drutamāgatya nirbhayaḥ trilokeśo bhavedindra tvaṃ pātāle nivatsyasi anyathā na vimokṣaste jīvan kvā'pi bhaviṣyati darśayitvā tataḥ senabahirenaṃ visarjaya

vyasarjayattaṃ daiteyaṃ bahiḥ senāniveśanāt jagāma rājasavidhaṃ bhayavihvalitā'ntaraḥ bhīto rātrau mahāmāyaḥ kauśikiṃ tanumāśritaḥ gaṇayitvā sarvasenāṃ brajantaṃ gaganā'dhvanaḥ gṛhītamātro māyāvī proḍḍīya gaganordhvataḥ ciraṃ yuddhvā śūlahatastayā muktaḥ kathañcana papāta puratastasya sūryasyodayanaṃ prati bhaṇḍāsuro japanmantraṃ pasparśā'ṅgeṣu pāṇinā utthāya praṇanāmā'śu daityarājaṃ puraḥsthitam mahārāja tvatsamakṣaṃ gato'mitraghnasaṃyutam athā'mitraghna evā'dau praviveśa mahācamūm madhuvanmakṣikābhiḥ sa samākrānto'tha śaktibhiḥ aśaktaḥ spanditumapi kva yuddhaṃ kva palāyanam tāvadbhīto'pyahaṃ durāt palāyanaparo'bhavam tato dinā'vasāne'haṃ māyāghūkatvamāsthitaḥ sā senā mahatī dṛṣṭā bhīmā bhīṣaṇanādinī darśanadeva senāyā yasyanti mṛtimāsurāḥ ahampūrvikayā yaddhaṃ kartumādau samutsukāḥ kumāribhiḥ koṭiśatasaṃkhyābhiḥ parivāritā bhaṇḍaputrān nihanmīti sā bravīti punaḥ punaḥ nāśayāmaḥ kṣaṇenā'tigarjantyaḥ samarotsukāḥ gajānaśvānasaṃkhyātān mahāśaktibhirāsthitān atha bālā pṛṣṭhatastu mahārathanivāsinī aprameyabalakrauryaśaurthayuktābhirāvṛtā pratyekaṃ rathamāruḍhā mahā'dbhutaparākramā

citravīryābhirabhitaḥ saṃvṛtāmantriṇī sthitā śaktibhirbaṭukādyaśca saṃyutā'tiruṣānvitā yatra te vadhavṛttāntasaṅgatirna hi saṃstutā nāśayediti me buddhirvyavasāyaṃ samāsthitā senaivaṃ śaktinicitā daityarāja ! vadāmi te sarvān daityagaṇānasmānatitiṣṭhati sarvathā vidyunmālī samabhavattūṣṇī daityasabhāgataḥ bhaṇḍāsurā'ṅghyrorapatad bhayavihvalitāntaram mahārāja tvadājñapto gataḥ śaktimahācamūm na me vīryaṃ balaṃ vāpi babhau śaktyagrataḥ kvacit kṣanena tāsāṃ grahaṇādvisaṃjño'bhavamañjasā sā kulādririvonnamrā kroḍāsyā kāñcanaprabhā tādṛgvidhaṃ śaktigaṇaṃ tasyāḥ krodhapradīpitam tasyā niyogānnito'haṃ śaktibhirmantriṇīpuraḥ saundaryakulasāraṅgī pūrṇatāruṇyagarvitā gītahāsyaparā nityaṃ viṇāvādananiṣṭhitā anvavekṣamahaṃ sarvasaubhāgyaikasamāśrayām tayā nīto mahārājñyāḥ samakṣamahamāśvatha sandeśaṃ vācayanmahyaṃ yattatte mantriṇīmukhāt brūyāstaṃ bhaṇḍadaityeśaṃ jīvane yadi te matiḥ nivasa tvaṃ parīvārayutaḥ pātālasadmani akṛtvaivaṃ na te mokṣo lokā'ntaragatasya ca iti tvayā tatra gatvā vaktvyo bhaṇdadānavaḥ karālakaravālodyatkarā tatra samāyayau mantranātāñca vṛtāntaṃ babhāṣe sā'nuyojitā

madbhṛtyāḥ śaktyo gatvā dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ samāgatāḥ iti vṛttaṃ tayā proktaṃ sarvamasmatsamāśrayam na tayā'viditaṃ kiñcinā'sti bāhyā'ntareṣu ca mantraste mantrito'pyatra nā'smābhirvidito'pi yaḥ citraṃ manye cirādatra vasannaviditañca yat yattvayā'pyatra no jñātaṃ tattvayā kathitaṃ nanu ekā'pi śaktiravarā sarvanno nāśayet kṣaṇāt endrādayo'pi vijitā mayā bhūyaḥ samāgame gṛhīto līlayaivā'śu hariṇā mṛgaśāvavat gṛhaṇantyahaṃ tathā tābhirgṛhīto balavānapi aśakyaṃ sarvathā daityairjetuṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ śrutvetthaṃ daityavacanaṃ bhaṇḍaḥ svā'ntaracintayat prasādamakarodadya cirakālā'bhikāṅkṣitam dhanyo'haṃ tripureśānīṃ dṛṣṭvā yuddhe'nubhāṣya ca vrajāmi lallokamamuṃ mahāsukhasamāśrayam daityasvabhāvavihitaścirabhārāyito nanu tathā'haṃ duḥkhadaṃ dehamamuṃbhāraṃ visṛjya tu nunaṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ niyutairdaha eṣa me ta eva bhogāstadrājyaṃ tāḥ striyastaśca saṅgatam nirviṇṇo'haṃ dṛḍhataramasmāt paryuṣitātmanaḥ parantu me virahitāḥ śociṣyanti priyā eme ādau vā'nantaraṃ vā'pi duḥkhadaia mṛtirbhavet evaṃ me tripurā devī kṛpāṃ kuryādabhīpsitām bhaktavāñchāsamadhikaphaladā sā nisargataḥ itthaṃ vicintya manasā namaskṛtya parāmbikām

parasaṃślāghanaṃ yattalloke kāpuruṣabratam balīvāpyabalo vā'pi śūrāstatra na bibhyati vamanniva netramukhāt krodhakākolapāvakam paśyantu daityā ye bhītāḥ tasyāmeti parākramam vadantameva daityeśaṃ sūtaḥ sarathamagrataḥ taṃ menire janāḥ kālaṃ jagatsaṃharaṇodyatam ityūcuḥ sahasā sarve bhītāśacā'surapuṅgavāḥ putrāḥ pautrāśca bhrātaraḥ sarvaḥ eva te athā'jñpto viśukreṇa kuṭilākṣaśca bhūpatiḥ tannivedya viśukrāya vikarṣanmahaīṃ camūm evaṃ pracalite daityarāje nikhilasenayā paṭahā'nakabherīṇāṃ vādyairddaityavigarjanaiḥ vandimāgadhasannādairhayadneṣitavṛṃhitaiḥ huṅkṛtā'hvānasaṃrāvaiḥ saṃhato hi mahāsvanaḥ senāsvanaṃ samākarṇya bhaṇḍadaityasamāgamam daṇḍinī tvaritā mantranāthāṃ prāpya vyajijñapat mahāsannāhasambhāro yuddhaṃ mahadupasthitam saṃrakṣantī śaktigaṇairmahārājñyā anuvraja eṣa śabdaḥ śrūyate vai gajavājisamākulaḥ sampannāthā'śvanāthābhyāṃ yutā citraparākramā vardhayitvā daṇḍanāthāṃmantriṇīñcā'pyabhāṣata daityarājasya sannāho mahān yuddhasamudyamaḥ samāgataḥ krurataro yudyatikrūravikramaḥ kiṃ vadāmi punargatvā tāṃ devīṃ gajavāhinīm prāha tatkālasadṛśaṃ vākyaṃ vikramabṛṃhitam

apramattatayā nūnaṃyoddhavyaṃ daityapuṅgavaiḥ sarvataḥ sā rakṣitavyā prāptā'smyahamapi drutam tathā saṃrudhya yoddhavyaṃ yāvanmama samāgamaḥ nāśayāmi kṣaṇenaiva tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā ājñaptaiva nirgatā sā śaktiḥ sandeśahāriṇī asaṅkhyaśaktisenābhiryutā krodhasamākulā didhakṣantīva lokāṃśca sarvān roṣāgninā kṣaṇāt pareṣāṃ hṛdayaṃ bhindan śrotramārgeṇa saṃviśan evaṃ śrīdaṇḍasāmrājñī jaitrayātrāmupā'kramat bālayā yuddhodyogavarṇanaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ niśmya praikṣadatyantayuddhotsukatayā diśam dadarśa daityasenāyāḥ sammardajanitaṃ rajaḥ jñātvā prāptaṃ daityarājaṃ sarvasenāsamāvṛtam laghucakrarathā'ruḍhā rathanetrīmacodayat adṛṣṭvaiva mahādevīṃ mantriṇīmabhisaṃyayau daityasenā'bhimukhato vāyuvegena saṃyayau aśvāruḍhā drutataraṃ tāmanu pratisaṃyayau upādravajjagajjvālāplāvanāyeva sarvataḥ anekakoṭimātaṅgasenāsaṃvalitā drutam noditā śīghrasaṃyāne rathavidyāviśāradā prāvṛṇnadīva jaladhiṃdaityasenāṃ vyavagāhata nadīvegavibhinne'bdhau nauriva syandanantu tat kuṭilākṣo daityasenāmukhe kuñjarasaṃsthitaḥ daityasenāpatiḥ so'pi dṛṣṭvā bālāṃ kumārikām ekākinīṃ rathāruḍhāṃ mṛdvaṅgīmaṣṭahāyanām

nirbhayā yodhayatyasmānindrādīnāñcatrāsanān lakṣaye sarvacihnāni kintveṣā taruṇī na ca kathaṃ tattanayā bālā senāvirahitā punaḥ nūnameṣaiva sarvānno jeṣyatīva vibhāti me viśukro vā viṣaṅgo vā rājā vā'ṣyahameva vā asmatsenā yatra nirīkṣati tatastataḥ koṭiśo nihatā daityāstrāsitā'smanmahācamuḥ patitāśca mṛtāścā'nye dhāvantyanye mahābhayāt patitāstatra śataśo nimagnā raktasindhuṣu roddhavyeyaṃ mayā yatnāddhiṅmāmevaṃvidhaṃsthitam naitadindreṇa marutā vāyunā'pi kṛtaṃ purā iti niścatya tāṃ roddhuṃ mahāgajasamāsthitaḥ yuyodhā'tibalo daityaḥ kuṣtilākṣastayā saha vavarṣa śaravarṣeṇa bālāṃ yuddhe'grataḥsthitām sā'pi bālā'ruṇā'bhāṅgī śaratīkṣṇatarāṃ'śubhiḥ ardayāmāsa daityasya senāṃ niśitasāyakaiḥ na veda kaścitkuśalo'pyatisūkṣamadṛśā'pi ca prāvṛṅgirimukhāttoyādhāramiva nirantarām kuṭilākṣaṃ samāsādya jaghān niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ tasya śastrā'srajālāni pratiśastrā'stravarṣataḥ ekena tīkṣṇabhallena cāpaṃ tasyā'cchinajjavāt iṣuṇā tāḍito vaktre girirājasamo gajaḥ mariṣyantamibhaṃ jñātvā kuṭilākṣo gadādharaḥ āyāntamativegena gadāhastaṃ niśāmya sā sa viddhastīkṣṇabāṇena bahuśoṇitamudgiran

atha bālā prāha sakhīṃ rathanetrīṃ smitā'nanā āyātyeṣā pṛṣṭhato me daṇḍinī śūkaradhvajā māmāsādya daṇḍanāthā pratirotsyati vai dhruvam ityuktā rathanetrī sā bālāṃ proce sakhī tadā dṛśyate kāñcanamayo rathastasyaiṣa eva hi mahārathibhiratyugraḥ saṃvṛto nanu dṛśyate śastreṇa sṛja mārgaṃ tvaṃ vāhayāmi tato ratham śaravṛṣṭyā nimeṣeṇa daityasenāsu madhyataḥ senāmukhaṃ mahāśūrairdaityairuddhamapi kṣaṇāt ashyāṃ śaradhārāṃ tāṃ prāpya daityāḥ pradudruvuḥ tathā'nye śastrasaṅghātapātena tilaśaḥ kṛtāḥ suphenilāstaraṅgaḍhyā uṣṇokakavahā eva andhībhūtā na viditā daityairvidrāvatatparaiḥ patanti saṅghaśastatra daityānāṃ mastakānyalam hā tāta putra susakhe bhrātarmitra hato'smyaham tadantare mukhe bhagne senāyāstasya vegataḥ viśukradaityo'varajo bhaṇḍadaityasya saṃyuge gacchantīṃ daitarājena yoddhumutsukitāṃ tadā niḥsīmabalavīryā'ḍhyā yudhyatyativicitritam tathā'pi samare śūrairyoddhavyaṃ sarvathā nanu kiṃ kariṣyati sā devī lalitā samare punaḥ iti niścitya nāgendramairāvatakulodbhavam rurodha bālāṃ rathagāṃ praviśya daityavāhinīm saṃrudhya śaravarṣeṇa shiṃhanādamatha'karot daityā naitatsamaṃ yuddhe kulajānāṃ palāyanam

āhārya vīryaṃ krodhañca nivartadhvaṃ samantataḥ kiṃ vakṣyatha gṛhe stribhiḥ pṛṣṭā yudhānnivartane viśukravacanaṃ śrutvā parāvṛttastatastu te daityasenābhirākrāntāḥ sā bālā rathasaṃsthitā atha tāṃ rathanetrīṃ sā sakhī prāha priyaṃvadā na te pārṣṇigrahā kāciścakragoptryadhividyate rathaṃ nivartayāmyeṣā senāyuktā punardrutam srutvā sakhīvacaḥ prāha prahasya mṛdubhāṣiṇī paryāptā me daityasenā yudhyantyā yudhi me dvacit manyase cedimaṃ paśya kṣaṇaṃ nirdaityalokakam devi nāstyeva me bhītiḥ sainye'pītaḥ "śatottare śaṅke śrīlitādevyā yadājñāmantarā tvayā brūhi śīghraṃ rathamahaṃ kvanayāmi raṇā'vanau triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ prāha śighraṃ naya rathaṃ yatrā'sau gajasaṃśrayaḥ ityājñptā kṣaṇādeva nināya syandanottamam śarasantatidhārābhiścakre'tiśithilāṃ tadā hatāstatra mahādaityāḥ kuliśā'streṇa sarvataḥ ekabāhvakṣicaraṇapārśsvībhūtāstathā pare niśāmya prāhiṇonnāgamairāvatakulodbhavam vavarṣa śaradhārābhirmaṇiśṛṅgamivā'mbudaḥ śaravarsaṃ dvayaṃ tattu tamobhūtaṃ raṇā'vanau jaghānā'karṇapūrṇena haste tāṃ rathavāhinīm tdadṛṣṭvā roṣatāmrākṣī garjantaṃ daityapuṅgavam bhallārdito gāḍhamūrcchāṃ viśukraḥ prāpatadgataḥ

atha bālā kṣaṇenaiva laghuhastakriyā'nvitā athaikenā'karṇaśareṇa nataparvaṇā indrāyudhaṃ girimiva dadāra sa śaro gajam saṃchinnaḥ krakaceneva mahāsthāṇurbabhau gajaḥ khaḍgahastaḥ khamutpatya tāṃ prahartumupadrutaḥ lāghavenaiva sā bālā dūrādekena patriṇā viśukramūrghni tanmagnaṃ kiñcidbāṇatrayaṃ yadā gāḍhaviddho'pi dhairyeṇa pakṣirāḍiva vegavān niśāmya hviyamāṇāṃ tāṃ rathanetryabravīdidadm jahi vīryeṇa daiteyaṃ yāvaddūraṃ na gacchati nirvartya muṣṭiṃ sudṛḍhāṃ pātayattasya mūrdhni gāḍhamūrchāsamāviṣṭo nipapāta mahītale priye śighraṃ naya rathameṣo'gre daityanāyakaḥ yathā nīlagirirhasairjalanirjharasaṃvṛtaḥ eṣā pṛṣṭhato me daṇḍanāthā camūvṛtā avaśyaṃ mama yuddhasya vihatiṃ sā kariṣyati utkaṇṭhitā'smi tadyuddhe sarvathā naya māṃ drutam yāvadbhaṇḍasya puratastāvadrathavarā'śrayaḥ anayā yuddhyamānasya daityarājasya sarvathā tadā cirārjitā kīrtirvyarthaṃ hīyeta sarvathā tasmādatra yathāśaktyā yatitavyaṃ bhavenmayā āyāntaṃ sammukhaṃ daityaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathavarasthitam priye! bhaṇḍena yoddhavye mahān vighno hyupasthitaḥ ityuktvā niśitān bāṇāṃścaturo visasarja ha athaikena dhvajaṃ chittvā sūtamekena patriṇā

moghaṃ sodyogamālakṣya turaṅgā'ntarasaṃśrayaḥ turageṇa samāyāntaṃ vātanunnā'bhrakhaṇḍavat śaravarṣamagaṇayannāyāntamābhimukhyataḥ akarodbyasumaśva taṃ hatāśvo'th viṣaṅgakaḥ samudramiva garjantaṃ kālāntakayamopamam sa gāḍhaviddho bāṇena bhramannuṣṇamasṛgvaman tadadbhutaṃ karma dṛṣṭvā daityā devāśca vismitāḥ bahudhā hyajayadyuddhe viṣṇutulyaparākramaḥ sarvān vijeṣyatyeṣaiva lalitā kiṃ kariṣyati bhaṇḍāsurasamakṣaṃ stvaṃ dṛṣtvā bālā mahāsuram anena yuddhvā santuṣye cirābhilaṣitantvataḥ atha bhaṇḍāsuro dṛṣṭvā bālāṃ sammukhasaṅgatām sa kāla eṣa samprāptaḥ śriyoktaściravāñchitaḥ nūnameṣaḥ kṣaṇo me'dya ghoradehaviyojakaḥ eṣā śrīlalitārājñyāḥ kumārdbhutavikramā māṃ nihantuṃ sā'pi devi ramāvacanagauravāt bhavatvenāṃ pūjayāmi tadabimbādutthitā'tmikām itthaṃ vicintya saśaraṃ jagrāha sudṛḍhaṃ dhanuḥ athā'paraṃ pauṣpamantramantritaṃ mūrdhani kṣipat śaro'paro mūrghni tasyā mālāvarṣamavā'kirat kumāryetanmahaścitraṃ prapaśyāmyasureśvare tvayi varṣaṃ kirantyāṃ vai śarāṇāmāhavā'vanau ahaṃ saṃśayayuktā'smi tanme dūrikuru drutam purā śrutaṃ yallalitā proktamatyantagūhitam śāpena daityatāṃ prāptastripurābhaktaśekharaḥ

māṃ matvā lalitāputrīṃ pūjayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ sa śaraḥ pañcaśākhātmā pasparśa tasya mūrdhani prasādamakaroddevī ceti saṃhṛṣito'bhavat athā'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ kumārībhaṇḍadaityayoḥ dvandvabhūtamanupamaṃ dvairathyaṃ śaravarṣaṇam devīṃ santoṣayāmīti yuyodha balavattaram jñātvā'nyonyaṃ śastrayogalāghavaṃ ślāghanāparau ityevaṃ yudhyatostatra kumārībhaṇḍadaityayoḥ kuliśā'straṃ pārvatasya nāgā'strasya ca gāruḍam tasya sārpaṃ tasya punarnākulaṃ tasya caiva hi mahāvyāghraṃ mṛgenadrañca tasya śārabhamastrakam kauberaṃ naiṛtañcaindraṃ raudraṃ mohanameva ca yuddhamāsīnmahāghoraṃ kumārībhaṇḍadaityayau prekṣāñcakrurvicitreṇa yuddhenā'tyantavismitāḥ hīyamānaḥ samabhavadbhaṇḍadaityo yadā tadā saṃvṛttā daityasenābhiḥ parivārya kumārikām bālāpi tān līlayaiva yodhayāmāsa sarvataḥ samprāptā daṇḍasamrājñī jitvā daityamahācamūm musalātmamahāvajrā'yudhena krūravikramā yudhyantīmekalāṃ daityaiḥ pa"yantī vismitā tadā bālāparākramavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ viśīrṇā parvata iva devendrā'yudhagauravāt viśīrṇāyāmapaśyat sā bālāṃ daityaiḥ susaṅgatām samarotsukitāṃ bhūyo dṛṣṭvā viṣmayamāgamat alaṃ bāle sāhasena yuddhena viṣameṇa te

daityānmahābalān bhīmān saṃyuge jitavatyasi śrīdevī vatsalā nūnaṃ bhavedvyākulitāntarā ityuktā'jñāpayacchaktimaśvasenā'dhināyikām mahārājñyeai nivedyaināmāgaccha tvaritaṃ punaḥ bālāyā rathāaviśya nyavartayata taṃ ratham mātareṣā yuddhabhuvo balātkārānnivartitā tvadājñāyā vayaṃ yāvadenāṃ yuddhānnivartitum praviṣṭā tatra daityānāṃ koṭayo balāttarāḥ nirjitau bhīmacāritrau tau viśukraviṣaṅgakau yuddhvā tenā'pi suciraṃ jitamāyaṃ cakāra vai ityuktvā niryayau sā'pi yudhāya turaśā'śrayā pariṣvajyā'tivātsalyānmūrdhnyu pājighradambikā anuktvaiva gatā yuddhe naitadaupayikaṃ tava eṣā'ruṇitanetrāntā niḥśvasantī punaḥ punaḥ śaṅkamānā tvayā tatra vighnaṃ naitamavedayam tāvakyā daṇḍarājñā'haṃ vṛthaiva samarāṅgaṇāt anyathā sā'pi madyuddhaṃ vimadā prāpya vai bhavet maivaṃ vatse ! punabrūryā ityuktvā sāntvayat parā yuyodha bhaṇḍadaityena yutena daityasenayā krodhā'veśasamāyuktā praviṣṭā'bhūtparasparam nārācairbhindipālaiśa khaḍgaśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ jaghnuryuddhe mahābhīme marṣitā balavattarāḥ keciddvidhā krṭāḥśastraiḥ kecittu tilaśaḥ krṭāḥ krandantaḥ putra mitreti hā bhrātastāta ityapi daityāḥ śiṣṭāḥ suvitrastāḥ palāyanaparāstadā

śoṇitodā vavurnadyaḥ phenilā bhīṣaṇasvanāḥ evaṃ vinihataprāyāṃ daityasenāmupadrutām punastatrā'bhavadyuddhaṃ krūraṃ śaktigaṇaiḥsaha sasarja māyayā dhvāntaṃ tatra varṣa śilāmayam vitrāsitā mūrcchitā cā'pyabhavadbhīmasaṛavā viśukreṇa mahāyuddhe saṅgatā'tidrutaṃ babhau vārāhī bhaṇḍadaityena yuyodhā'tiruṣā'nvitā asaṅkhyagajasainyena yutā sampatkarī parā vavarṣa śaravarṣeṇa viśukraṃ māyayā yutam prativarṣeṇa daityo'pi vavarṣa viśikhātmanā so'pyanyadādade cāpaṃtañcā'pyeṣā samācchinat athā'tikrodhasaṃyukto viśukro'dbhutavikramaḥ bhallā'hatabhujāttasyā nyapatattanmahaddhanuḥ jagarja patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā hastāścāpaṃ mahattaram tayorabhūnmahadyuddhaṃ kariṇoragayoriva dantā'kramairmahāśabdairmuhūrtamatibhīṣaṇam ākramya bhūmau vegena nipātya radanadvayam evaṃ nikṣiptamātrastu cītkurvan kuñjaradhipaḥ patantaṃ bāhanebhantamālakṣya sa mahāsuraḥ prāharat kumbhayormadhye sarvaprāṇena roṣitaḥ apā'sarat pañcadhanurmātraṃ cītkārabhairavaḥ tameva vāhanaṃ tasyā sampatkaryā yuyodha ha babhañja tad dvidhā madhye samādāyaikakhaṇḍakam evaṃ hatā sā balavadīṣatkaśmalamāgatā mūrdhni tasya viśukrasya ruṣā sampatakarī balāt

kṛttapakṣaḥ śaila iva patāta vasudhātale ālakṣya tadbhaṇḍasutaḥ yudhyamānaḥ samīpataḥ evaṃ parājitaḥ sampannāthayā sa mahāsuraḥ vividhairastraśastraiśca yudhyantaṃ taṃ mahāsuram tāḍito gadayā ceṣanmūrcchāṃ prāpya punarjavāt samādāyā'śvasenāsu vicacārā'ntakopamaḥ chinnamūrdhāṅgacaraṇāḥ prapetuḥ saṅghasaṅghaśaḥ baddhvā pāśena gadayā sā'śvaṃ hantuṃ samudyatā antardhānaṃ yayau sāśvomāyayā māyināṃ guruḥ daṇḍanāthā ca bhaṇḍena yuyodha balasambhṛtā parākrameṇā'kramata bhaṇḍāṃ kolamukhī yudhi muṣṭiyuddhe ca daityeśamatyaricyata daṇḍinī māyāṃ prāduścakāroścairmāyināṃ śekharo'suraḥ śilāvarṣaṃsarpavarṣañca pāvakam siṃhāṃśca śarabhānāṇḍabheruṇḍānasṛjadyudhi pratikriyā'strasandhānairnāśayāmāsa sarvataḥ nabhasyantarhito bhūtvā yuyodha saratho'suraḥ śastrā'śanigaṇopetaṃ śaktisenābhayaṃkaram bhinnasetudakamiva viluptā'bhūt samantataḥ utpapātā'tivegena sāyudhā nabhaso'ṅgaṇam mṛgayāmāsa daityeśaṃ nabhasyandhatamovṛte apahatya mahāmāyāmāsasāda mahāsuram gadayā'bhyāhananmūrghni vajrā'hata ivā'drirāṭa punaḥ sā gadayaivā'śu rathamaśvāṃśca sārathim tāvanmūrcchāvinirmukto gadāhasto hāsuraḥ

athā'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ vārāhīdaityarājayoḥ muhūrtamātraṃ yuddhvaivaṃ balotasiktaṃ mahāsuram tāvanmatvā nijātmānaṃ hataṃ musalaghātataḥ nūnaṃ proktaṃ ramādevyā yat purā na tadanyathā tripurā sā mahādevī bhaktavāñchitapūraṇī daitye vicintayatyevamabhavannābhasaṃ vacaḥ amogho musalaste'yaṃ sannivarya vai drutam mocayattaṃ sīragarbhānmatvā'vadhyaṃ sureśvaram daityasenāśaktigaṇairgāḍhaviddhā palāyitā lalitāyai śaktisenāṃ samavāpyā'bhitaḥ sthitām ajīvayadvirujayat tato hṛṣṭāñca tāṃ camūm puro'vrajadaśvanāthā senayā daṇḍanāyikā gajavāditraśabdaughaiḥ khyāpayantī svakaṃ jayam bhaṇḍāsuraparābhavo nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ āsādya mantriṇīṃ devīṃ praṇamya jayamādiśat atha gatvā tayā sārdhaṃ mahārājñīṃ praṇamya ca bhaṇḍāsuro'pi daityānāṃsenayā naṣṭaśeṣayā śūnyakaṃ nagaraṃ prāpya jagāmā'ntaḥpuraṃ svakam brūyurnātha kimadya tvāṃ paśyāmaḥ kṛpaṇaṃ yathā prāha patnivacaḥ śrutvā jñātvā svā'bhimataṃ śubham abhavat prakaṭstāsu priyāḥ śṛṇuta me vacaḥ viditaṃ te nāradokteḥ sarvaṃ me samabhīpsitam kintu daityeṣu svarūpaṃ nigūhitumiti sthitiḥ yadi te niścyo yuddhe hatā yāsyāmaḥ tatsthitam tatte mārgaḥ pravidito vadā'smākaṃ kathaṃ gatiḥ

śrutvā proktaṃ priyābhistat prāha harṣasunirbharaḥ na bhavedanyathā hyetat sarvathā kāranam bruve nūnaṃ sā me'brabīdevaṃ tripurā'smatsamāśrayā diśatyasādhyamapi ca tato naḥ syāt samīhitam tallokaṃ tadbhavedevaṃ sarvathā 'pi na saṃśayaḥ gantavyamiti tatrāpi bhavedeva tathā 'pyaham nūnaṃ loke suhṛdbandhuvaidhuryaṃ jātu vai kṣaṇam etāvat prārthyate nūnaṃ na bhavet sakṣaṇaḥ kvacit sā sādhayati bhaktānāmasābhyamapi vāñchitam śokaṃ jahatha rāj~yo'tra prāpto'bhudaya ucchritaḥ athā'gatā viśukrādyā bhrātaro mantriṇastathā praṇamyā'surabhūpālaṃ viviśuḥ svasvaviṣtare kṛtā'ñcjaliḥ praṇamyā.'ha vardhayitvā'dbhutaṃ vacaḥ nāśitā'khiladaityānāṃ buddhirnītisamānugā viśukraḥ so'pi vimataṃ prāha svārthaviṣaryayam bhāvyarthasyā'nurodhena bhuddhimunmeṣayatyalam jīvatsvasmāsu daityeṣu pa"yāmyetadasāmpratam viśukra kiṃ vadāmyadya kālasyaivaṃ viparyaye yasya yuddhe viṣṇumukhā yūyo jātāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ so'dyā'hamabalāsaṅghairvyarthayuddhe kadarthitaḥ kāle mṛtiḥ ślāghyatamā nedṛśasya kadarthanā daityeśaivaṃ nar'hasi tvaṃ bhāṣituṃ karuṇaṃvacaḥ naisargikaste dharmo'yaṃ strīṣu śastraparāvṛtiḥ daityeṣvavanyatamo'pyekasvayā'jñapto muhūrtataḥ tvaṃ tiṣṭhā'ntaḥpure krīḍhan suravāragaṇaiḥ saha

ityukvā parśvataḥ praikṣat kuṭilākṣaṃ camūpatim yuvarāja kimevaṃ tvaṃ bravīṣi mayi jīvati senāsenādhipaiḥ sākaṃ gatvā'haṃ sādhayāmi tām ityuktvā praṇipatyaitānniryayau nagarādbahiḥ athā'gatya durmadā'khyovāhinīṣo mahābalaḥ prāhā'haṅkāraśailasthaḥ praṇamyā'tmacamūpatim avalāvijayenaiva prayāṇaṃ vaḥ susammatam muhūrtamātrādyadi tāṃ nā'neṣyāmi tatastvayā vādayan jaitrayātrā'ṅgavāditrāṇi muhurmuhaḥ daityasenāsamārabhmakolāhalamaharavam gatvā śrīmātaraṃ natvā mantriṇī daṇḍinīmapi yayatuḥ śaktisenābhirasaṅkhyābhiḥ samāyute raṇakolāhalā'khyānaṃ prāleyā'dririvonnatam tāruṇyāmbhodhilaharī lāvaṇyaughasamudrikā daityāmbudheḥ śoṣaṇāya śarān bhānukaropamān asaṅkhyā vāraṇā'ruḍhā śaktyaścā'pi tādṛśāḥ pratyekaṃ tādṛśī śaktirgarjane tryaṅkuśagrahā kasmiṃścidekā saṃruḍhā'nekāścā'nyeṣu saṃsthitāḥ grasantīva daityasenāṃ vyāpya bhūmimuṣā'yayau daityasenāṃ samāseduste yuddheṣvanivartinaḥ pravṛttaḥ "śastrapāto'pi prāṇacoramahāravaḥ gṛghrakākakaṅkaghūkabhāsakekyadhisaṃśrayāḥ caṇḍaśūlakhaḍgacakrabhindipāladharāḥ pare evaṃvidhairdaityagaṇaiḥ sametā śaktivāhinī parasparaṃ kṣipantaste vākyaiḥ kaṭurasodayaiḥ

ityādibahuvākyāni vadantyaḥ śaktyo raṇe evaṃ pravṛtte samare prāṇadyute bhayaṅkare evaṃvidhāḥ śaktyo'pi daityahetibhirāhatāḥ jaghnuḥ pratyarthināṃ vṛndaṃ śastrairdantaiśca muṣṭibhiḥ anye bhagnairathāṅaiśca hetibhiryuyudhurbhṛśam bavurnadyo lohitaughāḥ saphenilataraṅgikāḥ palāyitaṃ gādhaviddhaṃ daśā'kṣauhiṇiśeṣitam uṣṭrā'ruḍho gadāhastaḥ kālā'ntakayamopamaḥ prāhiṇicchaktisenāsu mahāvegaṃ mahābalam sṛkkiṇīprāntavigalanmāṃsapiṇḍā'bhajihvakaḥ phenapiṇḍānudgiraṃśca mūtrayan pṛṣṭhato bahu nāśayan daśanaiścaiva vyacaracchaktisainyake śaktisenā'ntaka iva kadanaṃ prakarodruṣā raṇakolāhalaṃ tasya nāśāya samacodayat ayudhyata viṣāṇā'grakumbhā'ghātairmuhurmuhaḥ evaṃ yuddhaṃ samabhavattumulaṃ karabhebhayoḥ nipātya pādenā'kramyā'karottaṃ karabhaṃ vyasum saṃbhrāmya pātayanmūrghnaiṃgadāṃ vāraṇakumbhyoḥ jānubhyāṃ vikalo bhūmiṃ prāptaḥ śoṇitamudgniran jahau prāṇān durmado'pi dvidhorasi vipāṭitaḥ adṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭato yāntiḥ śaktīrjīvitahetave durmadavadho nāma ṣaṭṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ kruddha ājñāṃ samādāya kuṭilākṣān mahābalaḥ vilokya punarāyāntīṃ daityasenāṃ nabhonibhām turaṅgā vividhāstuṅgāstaraṅgā iva rejire

phenapiṇḍanibhānaśvānāruḍhāḥ kanakaprabhāḥ aparāḥ kālajīmūtanibhavājisamāśrayāḥ dhanurbāṇadharā nīlaratnakoṭīraśobhitāḥ kuruvindasamānāṅgyaḥ pāṭalāṃśukabhūṣaṇāḥ evaṃ vicitrā'bhrayutasandhyā'kāśanibhā camuḥ bherīkāhalagośṛṅgapaṭahā'nakanisvanaḥ huṅkārā'hvānavikṣepā'sphoṭasaṃrāvamāṃsalaḥ atha pravṛttaḥ samaraḥ karālo'suvikarṣaṇaḥ turaṅgakhuravikṣepavidhūtarajasāṃ gaṇaḥ kṣaṇaṃ kuhuniśīthā'bhaṃ jātaṃ hīnā'valokanam rajo'ndhakāraḥ saṃśāntaḥ punarāsīnmahāraṇaḥ balīyasībhirdaityānāṃ śaktibhisteja āhṛtam chinnapādakaraśrotrakukṣipṛṣṭhā mahāsurāḥ vadanto hā hatāsmeti tvaktvā yuddhaṃ vidudruvuḥ aśvāruḍho mahaścāpaṃ vikarṣan sāyakān kṣipan śaravarṣaiḥ kuraṇḍā'bdanirmuktaiḥ śaktivāhinī bhagnāyāṃ śaktisenāyāmaśvāruḍhā samāsadat taptahemanibhāmacchadukūlā'bharaṇojjvalām duṣṭe'baliptā'si ciraṃ mocayāmyavalepakam tvāṃ nihatya raṇe paścānmukta syāṃ bhrātṛdoṣataḥ evaṃ proktā roṣitā'śvāruḍhā tīkṣṇaiḥ śaraistribhiḥ dvitīyena ca koṭīraṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale hatā'śvo bhraṣṭamukuṭo vihato balavaddhṛdi kṣaṇena mūrcchānirmuktaḥ prāha tāṃ raṇamūrdhni śrutvetyāha punardevi dhiktvaṃ jīvasi daityaka !

paśyemaṃ taṃ jīvaharaṃ śaraṃ śatrumadā'paham devyāścāpaṃ praciccheda śareṇā'nataparvaṇā atha daityo'pi khaḍgena tasyāḥ khaḍgaṃ dvidhā'karot khaḍgaprahāranirbhinnamastako'śvo hyapa'kramat ākṛṣya prāharanmūrghni sṛṇinā dīptatejasā evaṃ kuraṇḍaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā senā'dhipo ruṣā kuṭilākṣaḥ prāha senādhīśo'ruṇitalocanaḥ yutā gatvā drutaṃ hatvā baddhvā tāṃ vāraṇe drutam sarpiṇyākhyā tayā sarve nanvajeyāḥ surā'suraiḥ viṃśatyakṣauhiṇīyutāḥ pratyekaṃ yoddhumāyayuḥ vajralomā gṛghrarathe gaje kākamukhastathā yuddhasaṃrambhadaityānāṃ niśamyā'timahādhvanim atha sammukhamāsādya sene te śaktidaityayoḥ cakrāte śaravarṣāṇi durānmeghatatī iva krodhadaṣṭadacchadāḍhyaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanam chidritaṃ śarajālena parighotpātapeṣitam gajavājimahāsenā śaktīnāmatiroṣitā dṛṭvā senāṃ hataprāyāṃ karaṅkādyā mahāsurāḥ kālyamānāṃ daityavaraiḥ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā parāhatām tābhyāṃ bhagnā yudhi tadā karaṅkādyā mahāsurāḥ bhīmarūpāṃ caṇḍaravāṃ vividhaṃ sarpamaṇḍalam atha sā mukhenetrādisambhūtaiḥ sarpamaṇḍalaiḥ tadvaiśasamatīvograṃ dṛṣṭvā kāścana śaktyaḥ prāpya tāṃ kolavadanāṃ śrīmātṛsavidhe sthitām daṇḍanāthe vayaṃ yātāḥ sampaddevyā sahā'suraiḥ

durmado nihato yuddhe sampadīśyā kuraṇḍakaḥ nāśitā'smābhiratyugrā evaṃ daityā vinirjitā pravartitā mahāmāyā sarpiṇyākhyā hi sāmpratam taiḥ sarpairnihatā daṣṭā baddhā bhasmīkṛtā parā devyau te śaravarṣeṇa sarpān ghanntyau muhurmuhaḥ nivārya tāṃ mantranāthā jñātvā'moghāñca sarpiṇīm atha dhyātvā kṣaṇenā'mbā jṛmbhamāṇā mukhā'mbujam kanakābhā mahāśaktirdevītālusamudbhavā tāṃ praṇamya sthitāmagre prāha śrīlaliteśvarī ityuktā sā kṣaṇenaiva samprāptā'havamaṇḍalam sarpabandhavinirmuktāḥ śaktyaḥ protthitāstataḥ taddṛṣṭvā sarpanivahavyāptaṃ śaktigaṇaṃ muhaḥ nakulāste mahāvegāścitravarṇāḥ suroṣitāḥ te sṛṣṭā nakulāḥ śīghraṃ tān sarpān sarvataḥ sthitān nakulastādṛśaiḥ sarpāḥ khaṇḍitā bhakṣitā api atha te nakulāḥ sarpān vināśyā'pariśeṣataḥ sarpiṇyāntu praṇaṣṭāyāṃ karaṅkādyā mahāsurāḥ tatasteṣāñca śastrāṇi vāhanānyapi sarvataḥ khaḍgacchinnottamāṅgāste nipeturvigatā'savaḥ jayaśabdairvardhyamanānnakulīnakulān hitām praṇamya jayavṛttāntamācakhyau vidhṛtā'ñjaliḥ nakulīparākrame karaṅkādivadho nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ kuṭilākṣo viniḥśvasya cintāmāpa mahattarām durmadaśca kuraṇḍaśca balinau nihatau raṇe ete karaṅkapramukhāḥ sarpiṇyāmoghayā yutāḥ

yā śrūyate śaktigaṇanāyikā lalitā'bhidhā aho ! kiṃ na bhavelloke viparīte vidhau nanu balaṃ kṣīṇaṃ caturthāṃ'śaṃsainyeśā balino hatāḥ pratijñāya śaktijayaṃ rājñe'haṃ kathamadya vai evaṃ cintāsamākrānte kuṭikākṣe camūpatau dṛṣṭvā viṣaṅgaṃ seneśaḥ kuṭikākṣaḥ samutthitaḥ atha dṛṣtvā viṣaṇṇā'syaṃ viṣaṅgaḥ sainyanāyakam tayā bhakteṣṭadāyinyā mohito daityapuṅgavaḥ tadvadā'śu kiṃ nimittaṃ samaṃ sarva karomyaham aviśāśañca śaktīnāṃ mahābhayamupasthitam mohito māyayā devyā babhdāṣe buddhimāniva vinā yuktyā na jīyeta mahābalavatā paraḥ mayā śaktijayo prāyo niścitaḥ sūkṣmabudhinā ahaṃ manye hatāḥ śaktigaṇā ityeva yuktitaḥ kūṭenaiva vijeyā sā tatkrmaṃ niścitaṃ bruve mahatyā daṃśitāḥ sarve viśukreṇā'pi saṃvṛtāḥ gantavyameva yaddhāya yathā śaktigaṇāḥ api tāvadrātrābandhakārairdetyairbahubhirāvṛtaḥ tasyā rathaṃ samāruhya tatratyā api kāścana lalitāmabalāṃ duṣṭāṃ śaktisaṅghaśiphātmikām tasyāṃ hatāyāṃ baddhāyāmapi vā śaktivāhinīm yā tu sā lalitā rājñīsukumārakarāṅghrikā evaṃ mayā vyavasitaṃ buddhyā'tyantapragalmayā "śrutvā viṣaṅgavacanaṃ kuṭilāks'śca bhūpatiḥ prahṛṣṭa utthāya ca taṃ taṃ drutaṃ sa pariṣasvaje

kāle jayavahā buddhirdurlabhā sarvathā nanu ciraṃ jīva rājakāryasādhakastvaṃ mato mama rājaputrān viśukrañcā'yāhi yudhāya sarvathā vayaṃ yadā śaktisenāṃ niyudhyāmastadā drutam ityukte kuṭilākṣe'tha viṣaṅgo nagaraṃ yayau māyāvimūḍairdaityeśaḥ sammataḥ saṃyayau drutam kuṭilākṣeṇa saṅgamya sarvasenāsamāvṛtaḥ viditvā daityarājasya sannāhamatisaṃvṛtam mantriṇī lalitādevīṃ natvā vṛttaṃ vyajijñapat vatse bhaṇḍāsurasyā'yaṃ saṃrambho dṛśyate mahān asmābhirapi gantavyaṃ niḥśeṣeṇa drutantu tat ityājñaptā kolamukhī sarvaśakticamūvṛtā nirgatā śaktisenā sā gajavājirathā'kulā yuddhavāditraninadairgajavājirathasvanaiḥ taṃ bhīmaṃ lokadalanaṃ śrutvā daityā mahāsvanam sa ghoṣaḥ senayormiśro vyarucadrodasīgataḥ athā'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ senayoḥ śaktidaityoḥ tathā daityān śaktyo'pi mamadrdurhetipātanaiḥ decit kṛpāṇinā madhye pāṭitāḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ keciścakreṇa saṃcchinnakandharodarabāhavaḥ amoghapāśaiḥ paritaḥ pāśitāḥ kecidañjasā vikṣatāḥ kecidurasi tomarā'ṅkuśasāraṇaiḥ athaśaktigaṇairbhagnā daityasenā pravidrutā anudrutāḥ śaktigaṇaiḥ śaraṇaṃ prepsavo'bhitaḥ taraṅgaiḥ kaṅkālagaṇān vāhayantyaḥ samedhitāḥ

evaṃ daityapravidrāvaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaṇḍā'nujastadā provācā'hūya vijñāya tānameyaparākramān anāthāniva yuddheṣu kālyamānān samantataḥ tapasā bhavatāṃ netre sūryaḥ svāṃ'śaṃ dadau kila ityājñapto bhrātṛyuto yayau śaktīrvihiṃsitum sūcīmukhaḥ karālākṣaḥ karaṭaśceti sapta te sa santapto'titarṣeṇa prayāti nidhanaṃ drutam evaṃ vidhāste senāyāṃ praviśya yugapattadā atha tāḥ śaktyaḥ sarvā daityānāmavalokanāt evamatyantasantāpatṛṣābhyāṃ samabhiplutam mantriṇīṃ daṇḍinīṃ tyaktvā sarvaṃ śaktigaṇaṃ yadā tannetravīryaṃ na tayoḥ pravṛttaṃ tanmahitvataḥ vicārya mantriṇī cā'pi viditvā ravyanugraham sasmāra manasā śaktiṃ tiraskaraṇikā'bhidhām samāruḍhā nīlavapurnīlāṃśukavibhūṣaṇā svasamākāraśaktīnāṃ koṭibhiḥ parivāritā āgatya mantriṇīṃ natvā prāha kiṃ saṃsmṛteti vai visarjayāmāsa punaḥ śaktīnāṃ śāntihetave ājñaptaivaṃ samāruhyā'dṛśyavāhanamuttamam nāśayāmāsa daityānāṃ senāṃ śastranipātanaiḥ andhībhūtāḥ kiñcidapi dadṛśurno kathañcana ciraṃ yuddhairvinirjitya tiraskaraṇikā tataḥ hate balāhakamukhe tiraskaraṇikāṃ surāḥ jahṛṣurdevatāmukhyā lokakaṇṭakanāśanāt evaṃ tiraskṛtirjitvā daityāṃstapanalocanān

āliṅgya te kṛtaṃ kṛtyamasādhyaṃ sarvathā tvayā evaṃ balāhakamukhe hate sūryo'stamāyayau tiraskaraṇikāyuddhe balāhakādivadho nāmā'ṣṭaṣaṣtitamo'dhyāyaḥ tripurāmāyayā muḍhāḥ saṅkalpajayaharṣitāḥ pārṣṇigrahavidhānāya preṣayitvā vidhāntaḥ viśukro mantriṇīṃ daṇḍarājñīṃ senāpatiḥ svayam ulūkajitprabhṛtayo gajavājivahe tathā astaṃ yāte savitarī sarvatastamasā'vṛte muhūrtamātraṃ (tat?) sandhyāprakāśairabhavadraṇaḥ abhavaddāruṇaṃ yuddaṃ śaktidānavasenayoḥ yuyudhuḥ śastrajālaiste śaktibhirdaityapuṅgavāḥ ācchādayannabhobhāgaṃ tārakāgaṇasaṃvṛtam yuyudhuḥ śaktidaityāṇāṃ gaṇāścā'krmayogataḥ śastraṇyanyeṣu yuñjanti tānyanyān ghātayanti hi tatra daityairhatā daityāḥ śaktibhiḥ śaktyastathā kecchistrairvinihatāḥ pare rathavigharṣitā evaṃ mahattare tatra sammrdda sati vaiśase antaṃ madhyamathā'diṃ vā senāyāḥ ke'pi no viduḥ jvālāmukhīṃ mahādevīṃ sasmāra tripurāṃśajām jvalatparvatasaṅkāśā jvālāvyāptadigantarā tadā daityāḥ śaktyo'pi yuyudhuḥ kramasaṅgatāḥ bālā bhaṇḍasutairyuddhaṃ vicitramatanodbhṛśam triṃśatsaṃkhyā ekakālaṃ yuyudhurbālayā dṛḍham bālāṃ samācchaduḥ śastrairdineśaṃ stuhinairiva nāśayāmāsa vegena tamaḥ sūryodayo yathā
