gadāprahārasambhinnakumbhadeśādgaṇeśituḥ jaghāna śūlena hṛdi viśukrasyā'tivegataḥ evaṃ viśukraṃ nirjitya yayau bhaṇḍarathaṃ prati vicārayat svāntaraṅge tamajeyaṃ vibhāvayan ajeyo'yaṃ mahāvīryaḥ sarvairdevāsurairapi śarstrahata imaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā tallokamāpnuyām nūnameṣa purā yuddhaṃ cakre yena mahaujasā tato'haṃ tāṃ samāyāsye yoddhaṃ śrīlalitāmbikām parvatā'bhaṃ mahābhīmaṃ parighodyatsupuṣkaram āsādya gajadaityaṃ taṃ yuyodha gaṇanāyakaḥ śaktyaḥ prakṛtiṃ prāpya niryuryuddhagetave aśeṣadaityasenānāṃ mantriṇī daṇḍinīyutā aśeṣaśaktisenābhirdaśitābhiḥ parivṛtā samāruhyebhasenābhirnirjagāmā'tisambhramāt aśvāruḍhā'śvasenābhirāvṛtā yuddhasambhramāt bālā praṇamya lalitāṃ prāha mañjulayā girā sadā yuddhavidhānāya samutsukitamānasām pādau mūrdhnā spṛśāmyeṣā dehyajñāṃ samarāya me ādye dine'pi me yuddhaṃ nā'sīnmānasapūraṇam adya me pūrayasvā'śāṃ cirādyuddhāya sambhṛtām prahasantī mantranāthāmukhaṃ samavalokayat kumāri ! śṛṇu me vākyaṃ yadi tvaṃ yoddhumicchasi ekena saha yudhyasva daṇḍinyā ca mayā saha praveṣṭavyaṃ kvacidvā'pi tavā'vāṃ pakṣasaṃśraye śrutvaivaṃ mantriṇīvākyaṃ prāha bālā'mbikā punaḥ

sarvathā bāṇamekaṃ vā visṛjedahamekala āyudhādini nāśyāni anyābhirjātu kutracit ekena yudhyasva raṇe devyādiṣṭe kathaṃ tvayā bhaṇḍaputra mahāśurā bhaṇḍatulyaparākramāḥ ekena teṣu yudhyasva yena yoddhuṃ samīpsitam praṇamya bhūyastairyuddhamayācata kṛtā'ñjaliḥ dadāvanujñāṃ samare āśliṣya prītipūrvakam mātaranyacchṛṇu vaco daṇḍinyesā mayā saha vyanāśayadyuddharasaṃ yadyāgacchenmayā saha yadi yuddhe punarvighnaṃ kariṣyati tadā śṛṇu evaṃ vadantīṃ bālāṃ tāṃ matvā ruṣṭāñca otriṇī devi śaṅkāṃtyaja mayi āgacchāmi tvayā saha tavā'jñāmanurudhyaiva purataḥ pṛṣṭo'pi vā iti śrutvā daṇḍinīṃ sā modādāśliṣya satvaram mantriṇī daṇḍanāthā ca svasvasyandanasaṃsthite atha śrīcakrarājākhyarathamāruhya sattavaram tatpṛṣṭhataḥ samāruhya timirastomasamprabham vikarṣantī śaktisenāmameyāṃ sāgaropamām yudhavādyacitraravo nemighoṣā'timāṃsalaḥ hayahveṣitasaṃrāvaivṛrvadhe'titarāṃ tadā lohitānāṃ mahā'sāravarṣaṇo'tibhayaṅkaraḥ drutaṃ vīryaṃ darśya te pa"ya me'dya parākramam śithilāṅgāḥ śaraiḥ kecit kecit paraśudāritāḥ niṣpiṣṭāḥ parighairanye cakraiśchinnagalāḥ pare bhindipālaiḥ śakalitā gadābhirbhinnamastakāḥ

saritaḥ śoṇitavahā vavustatra sahasraśaḥ palāyitā krandamānā śaktiśastrā'tivedhitā jalāśayācchinnabandhāttoyānīva kṣayaṃ gatā caturbāhumukhāstriṃśatsaṅkhyāścitraparākramāḥ rathā'ruḍhā śaktisenāṃ jaghnuḥ sāyakavṛṣṭibhiḥ śastrā'stratejo daityānāmasahyaṃ prāpya sarvataḥ sarvasenāsamāgamavarṇanaṃ nāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ hayā'nana ! mahāścaryamākhyānaṃ samyagīritam yuddhaṃ tayoḥ kathamabhūttanmamā'cakṣva pṛcchataḥ gaṇanāthamahāyuddhāṃ pravaktumupacakrame gaṇanāthamahāvīryasambhṛtāṃ saṃyutāṃ rasaiḥ muhūrtamātramabhavattayoryuddhaṃ suduḥsaham tulyarūpāṃstulyajavāṃstulyasāhasavikramān sasarja svātmanastulyān gaṇeśānapi koṭiśaḥ yuyudhuścitraśastrastraistadadbhutamivā'bhavat dadṛśuḥ prekṣakā bhūtvā yuddhasaṃrambhavismṛteḥ kaścicchūlāhataḥ kaściścakreṇa śakalīkṛtaḥ kaścinnighṛṣṭa urasā kaścitpādaprapeṣitaḥ evaṃ te nāśitā daityā daityasṛṣṭā gajānanaiḥ yuyodha balavāṃstatra gaṇeśenā'tisāhasī sañjhāra gaṇapatīn svāṅge nimiṣamātrataḥ anekaśastrā'stragaṇaiḥ saṅkulaṃ subhayaṅkaram sahastrā'syastaddviguṇabhujaścitrā'yudhairvṛtaḥ sṛṣṭaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ śastragaṇaṃ nāśayad gaṇanāyakaḥ ciccheda yugapattasya dhṛtaṃ śastrasahasrakam

mahatyā gadayā nūnaṃ nighnatoritaretaram śakalībhūya patitā tato daityo nirāyudhaḥ gadāpratihatā'ṅgena papāta bhuvi sā vṛthā kṣiptaṃ kṣiptaṃ vṛthā bhūmāvapataddehasaṅgataḥ dṛṣṭvā daityaṃ sarvaśastrairajeyaṃ sa gaṇādhipaḥ athā'bhavattayormuṣṭiyuddhamatyantadāruṇam taṃ tato bāhubandhena baddhā daityaṃ nipātayat evaṃ vidārito daityo jahau prāṇāṃstadā raṇe yudhāyā'bhyājagāmā'śu gaṇeśo'dbhutavikramaḥ cintayalllitāṃ devīṃ bhītastasya parākramāt iti pūraya madvāñchāṃ prapannastvatpadā'mbujam sasmāra sindhuramukhaṃ cakrarājarathasthitā praṇamya prāha mātaḥ kiṃ smṛto yuddhavidhau sthitaḥ vatsā'laṃ yuddhavidhinā tiṣṭha matpārśvato'dhunā ityājñapto gaṇeśāno virarāma niyuddhataḥ tān sayakaiḥ kirantī sā bālā yuddhe samāsadat atyadbhutakriyāṃ yuddhe bālāṃ vavrūraṇā'jire bālāṃ rathasthāṃ vavṛṣurgarjanto yudhdhadurmadāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ śaktyaḥ sarvā bālāmbājñāṃ bravīmi vaḥ prayoktavyaṃ śastragaṇaṃ daṇḍyā sā me'nyathā bhavet iti saṅghoṣya senāsu mantriṇyā sahitā svayam atha śrutvā daṇḍarājñyāḥ śāsanaṃ muditā hi sā siddharṣidevatāmukhyāḥ paśyantyā'kāśamāśritāḥ atha daityotsṛṣṭaśastravṛndairācchāditā'bhavat dṛṣṭvā channāṃ śastragaṇairvimatāḥ śaktyo'bhavat

vināśya tāṃ śastravṛṣiṃ bhūyaḥ sarvān jaghāna ha āyudhāni vāhanāni nāśayiścitravikramā atha tīkṣaṇaiḥ śarairdaityānnāśayat sā'tivegataḥ na lakṣyate'tinipuṇadṛśā kenā'pi sarvathā prasaranti śarāstīkṣṇā dikṣvantaravihīnataḥ phalānīva supakvān."caṭamāaravāḥ nirantaratayā viddhāḥ sahasrākṣa ivā'bhavan kecidvakṣasi saṃviddhā hṛtaprāṇāḥ sthiraṃ sthitāḥ keciccharā'hatervegānnīyante gatajīvanāḥ evaṃ tayā muhūrtena koṭiśo daityapuṅgavāḥ na tatra daityaḥ śūro'pi kaścit svātmā'vane vibhuḥ na daityā yuddhamatyantamekākinya viduḥ kvacit śaktisenā nabhaḥsaṃsthā devādyāśca samantataḥ athaivaṃ nighnatīṃ bālāṃ dṛṣṭvā daityāścamūṅgatāḥ hā hatāḥsmo na ceyaṃ vai yoṣidbālā kumārikā adya niḥśeṣitaṃ sainyaṃ daityānāṃ bhavati kṣaṇāt śastradhārāsunicite mārgamaprāpya nirgame kecchiraiḥ susaṃviddhāḥ patitāḥ "śavarāśiṣu evaṃ tadā daityasainyaṃ prāyo naṣṭaṃ palāyitam rathāḥ siṃvāhā mahācāpadharā bhṛśam mahāmeghā iva śyāmā garjantī mṛgarājavat tairanekaiḥ kumārī sā viṣṇutulyaparākramaiḥ mantriṇīdaṇḍinīmukhyā dṛṣṭvā bālāparākramam devi nūnaṃ sā kumārī na śeṣayitumarhati līlayaivā'dya niḥśeṣaṃ kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

teṣāṃ vāhān dhvajaṃ chatraṃ yugapannāśayaccharaiḥ śarāsanaṃ kramātteṣāṃ ciccheda supatatribhiḥ parāmṛśurnihantuṃ tāṃ yāvattavadiyaṃ drutam evaṃ nirāyudhā daityā jātāstasyāḥ parākramam evaṃ bālamahākālagrastān yudhi niśāmya vai rakṣituṃ tān rājaputrānabhyāyayaturāśu vai dadṛśe śakhavarṣāṇi kurvantau kālameghavat nivārayallīlayaiva tatastāṃ daityavāhinīm nāmaśeṣāṃ kṛtavatī tatastāvatiroṣitau dṛṣṭvā śarairvāhanebhān yuddhe'nāśayadañjasā mūrcchitau petaturbhūmau vajrā'hatanagāviva tānivṛttān samālokya virathānakarot kṣaṇāt prāhare bhaṇḍadāyādāḥ śūrāṇāṃ vaḥ kathaṃ tvidam śutvā kaṭurasodarkaṃ bhāṣitaṃ te'timāninaḥ dhiṅmugdhe bālikāṃ dṛṣṭvā dayamānasvabhāvataḥ tat paśya sadyastvāṃ kurmo vimadāṃ tat stharībhava pratyekaṃ niśitairbhallaistacchirāṃsi cakartaha hāhākāraḥ samudabhūd daityānāṃ vāhinīmukhe jayaśabdo mahānāsīcchaktisenāsu sarvataḥ bhaṇḍaputravadhakaraṇavarṇanaṃ trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ bālāṃ bhūyaḥ samālakṣya mantriṇīdaṇḍanāyike anujñātā punaryuddhaṃ yāsyāmaḥ kartumañjasā tvamasādhyaṃ kṛtavatī naitadasmacchakaṃ kvacit āruhya cakrarājākhyarathaṃ natvā parāmbikām vijayañca tataḥ śrutvā tuṣṭā śrīlalitāmbikā

bhaṇḍaputrān hatān dṛṣṭvā hā hetyuccairvicukruśuḥ putranāśaṃ niśamyā'tha bhaṇḍadaityo'tiduḥkhitaḥ aho me vipulo mohaḥ smṛtibhraṃśaḥ samudgataḥ yathā prārthitaṃ me tattathaiva kṛtaṃ tathā yāntu pañcatvamatha vai tayā devyā raṇe hatāḥ iti me prāgvyavasitaṃ prārthitā ca parāmbikā cakre tatra mahāmoho vṛthā kiṃ māmupāgataḥ tanme'vaśeṣitaṃ kāmaṃ pūryā'śu maheśvari ! māṃ sayoṣidgaṇaṃ śīghraṃ yuddhe śastrāgnipāvitam kadā'haṃ candracūḍālaṃ netratrayasuśobhanam paśyan śrīmātṛvadanaṃ dagdhastatsāyakā'gninā prārthayanniti tadrūpaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram tāvattatrā'jagmatustau daityarājasya brātarau amaṃsatuḥ putraśokabharākrāntaṃ sumūrcchitam tayoḥ śamaparaiḥ śabdairdhyeyānnirgatamānasaḥ svarūpagopanārthaṃ sa brātroḥ sammukhataḥ sthitaḥ hā putrā māṃ parityajya pitaraṃ duḥkhasāgare mātaro vo'tivātsalyakātarā īdṛśīṃ daśām ityādi vilapantaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tau bhrātarau tadā alaṃ daityeśa ! śokena dhairyavīryā'pahāriṇā jvaro nau dehaṃ karīṣamiva pāvakaḥ gatvā'vāmekapātena tāṃ hatvā niśitaiḥ śariḥ jīvantīṃ vā mṛtāṃ vā.pi vaddhvā neṣyāva āśu vai yuddhārthamabhyāyayaturativīryaparākramau pṛthak śaktimahāsenāpārśvabhāge prapetatuḥ

śatā'kṣauhiṇīsenābhirviṣaṅgaḥ prāpatadbalī tṛtīye yuddhadivase prātaḥ sūryodayaṃ prati tadābhavanmahāśabdaḥ śaktisenāsu pārśvayoḥ abhūtāṃ śaṅkite'tyantamūcatuḥ śrīparāmbikām śruyate bhairavataro daityāḥ kapa'yodhinaḥ tadyāva āvāmanujānīhi śīghraṃ maheśvari celatuḥ samarāyā'śu pṛthak śaktigaṇāvṛte niryayau śrīcakrarājarathadakṣiṇadrārataḥ mahāsiṃhayugaṃ pārśve sairibhāggraṃ tathā puraḥ tatparśve siṃhasaṃvāharathāruḍhe vicelatuḥ baṭukaiḥ kālikāvṛndairvarāhamukhaśaktibhiḥ evaṃ cakrarathadvārāduttarasmāśca mantriṇī saptaparvayute vedaharidaśvapracālite śukādyā sārikādyā ca śyāmalā dakṣapārśvagā laghu"yāmalikā pṛṭhe caivametā rathā'śrayāḥ mantriṇyaṅgasasudbhūtāḥ śyāmalāḥ koṭikoṭiśaḥ sarvāḥ ṣoḍaśavārṣikyastāruṇyaśrīniṣevitāḥ kaṭākṣamandahāsābhyāṃ mohayantyo'khilaṃ jagat kāvyā'lāparasā'bhijñā gītavādyavinoditāḥ mantranāthā vāhinī sā suśubhe'titarāṃ tadā athā'bhavacchaktisenādaityasenāsamāgamaḥ atha dhvanadyuddhavadyahuṅkārā'sphoṭani'svanaḥ senayorubhayostatra badhirīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ daityasenāmukhataṭaṃ vidīrṇaṃ śatadhā'bhavat daityasenāhṛdaṃ śaktisenāstrotaḥ samantataḥ

"śastrā'gnibhirdaityasenāvanaṃ cakrurhi bhasmasāt anye kṛpāṇinā cchinnanikhilāṅgā gatā'savaḥ itare śūlasūtreṣu protā maṇigaṇā iva evaṃ vināśyamānāyāṃ senāyāṃ śaktisenayā rathenā'bhyaderavacchaktivāhinīṃ śastravarṣaṇaiḥ śaktisenā'pi yuyudhe viśukre ca balīyasī jīmūtakāyo devāriḥ karambhaḥ śikhibhāṣaṇa viśukrātmajasaṅkhinnāṃ niśāmya śaktivāhinīm viśukraputrānāsedurvarpantya iṣusantatim ciraṃ yuddhvā śaraistatra rathaṃ sūtaṃ śarāsanam jaghāna tīkṣṇadhāreṇa khaḍgena rathavāhanam tāvacchukaśyāmalikā ardhacandreṇuṇā javāt devāriṇā śārikākhyā saṅgatā yuddhakarmaṇi svakīyagadayā'plutya jaghānā'suramastake saṅgītaśyāmalā yuddhaṃ karambheṇa cakāra ha sāhitya"yāmalā yudhdhvā balinaṃ śikhibhāṣaṇam triśūlaṃ tena dalitahṛdayaḥ prāpa tadvyasuḥ channarūpaḥ "yāmalāya rathapārṣṇiṃ samāsadat dṛṣṭvā laghuśyāmalākhyā sannidhānaṃ samāgatam jaghāna mūrghni tarasā khaḍgenā'tibalīyasā viśukro bhraṣṭamukuṭaḥ krodhāruṇitalocanaḥ tāvacchareṇa daityasya gadāṃ ciccheda saptadhā tasyā jaghāna tāvat sā prāharanmūrghni sāyakaiḥ īśatprajñastāvadenaṃ grahītauṃ laghuśyāmalā pratibuddhastāvadasau matvā svasya hi bandhanam

tāvaj jñātvā rathasthānāḥ śaktyo ripumantike tāvanmatvā śaktigaṇaṃ dusahaṃ daityaśekharaḥ tatra dṛṣṭvā mrṭān putrān śokasaṃvignamānasaḥ prajvalan śaktisenāṃ tāṃ vidhamaccharavarṣaṇaiḥ mantriṇī sāyakā'sārairdhanurjīmūtani'sṛtaiḥ tīkṣṇasāyakadhārābhirviśukro'tyantavikṣataḥ nīlādrirvṛṣṭidhārābhirgairikārasavatkṣṇam vicitraśastraśalabhairācchādayata mantriṇīm tamālamañjarīvā'timakarandasubṛṃhitā ākārṇapūrṇabhallena dhanurjyāmācchinaddrutam tāvattikṣṇapṛṣatkena muṣṭideśe jaghāna tam patitaṃ dhanurādātuṃ yāvannamro mahāsuraḥ sa tāvadiṣuṇā bhinnamūrdhā gāḍhasumūrcchayā atha kṣaṇena mantriṇyā nāśitaṃ daityavāhanam tāvanmūrcchāvinirmukto dadarśā'havasādhanam śīrṇa rathāṅgamādāya nihantumupasaṃyayau śareṇā'bhihatāddhastādrathaṅgaṃ prāpatat kṣitau mantriṇīhastagaṃ cāpraṃ bhaṅktuṃ yāvat samācchinat dṛṣṭvā viśukraṃ nihataṃ vidrutā daityavāhinī jayaśabdaṃ śaktigaṇāścakrurdevamukhā api viśukravadhavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ tadā daityaśakticamborabhavadbhairavo raṇaḥ baṭukānāṃ triśulādyardetyā bhūyo'bhivikṣatāḥ dṛṣtvā daityacamūṃ śaktigaṇaiḥ prāyo vināśitām viṣaṅgaputrāḥ proddaṇḍavikramā vīryavattarā

indraśatruḥ surā'rātirmahākukṣirmadoddhataḥ tairhanyamānāṃ tāṃ śaktivāhinīmabhivīkṣya tu andhinī mohinī caiva bhairavaḥ kālakarṣiṇī karālavaktriṇa yudhi jambhinī saṅgatā'bhavat gadayā'bhijadhānā'śu varāhaṃ śaktivāhanam īṣat papāta purato jānubhyāmavaniṅgataḥ viśikhaḥ stambhanīṃ prāpya yuyodhā'tibalī dṛḍham jaghāna tairmūghni lagnairviśikho'tivyarājata so'pi kruddho'tivegena tīkṣṇadhāreṇa karṇinā tāvatkruddhā stambhinī ca gārdhrpatreṇ tejinā atha tasya kṣaṇenaiva niśitairvisikhaistribhiḥ sa chinnadhanvā'tiruṣā triśūlamatibhāsvaram chittvā triśūlaṃ bhallena śiro daityasya pātayata śastrairastraranekaiśca kṛtapratikṛtairaram cirāṃ yuddhvā tena tatra karṇāntā'kṛṣṭapatriṇā papāta mūrcchito gāḍhaṃ chinnapakṣa ivā'drirāṭ dvāśabdaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā samunnamya ca bāladhim kāścitpratyakpādaghātairdaśanaiścā'vadhūnanaiḥ evaṃ śaktīrvinighnantaṃ kharaṃ dṛṣṭvā'ndhinī tadā sa vidvastīkṣṇabāṇena mūrcchitaḥ prapatadbhuvi vegena gadayā tasyā vāhanaṃ tāḍayadbalī parato yojanādbhūmau papāta suvimūrcchitaḥ muñcan suśīghraṃ kvāśabdaṃ saghargharamahāravam pāścātyapādaghātena santāḍya balavattaram śṛṅgābhyāṃ dārayat kukṣiṃ bhūmāvāsphālya vegataḥ

vimūrcchastāvadabhyetya vibhāṇḍo'bhihanat padā apāharadatikrodhāt kṛttamūrddhāmamāra saḥ mohinī garuḍāruḍhā gṛghrastho vikaṭekṣaṇaḥ sapakṣayoḥ parvatayorivā'tyantavicitritam nakhaistuṇḍairdāritāṇgo mamāra patito'vanau mohinīcakrasamcchinnagalo mṛtyumupāgataḥ svavāhenā'tibhīmena yuyodhā'tyantasāhasī koṭisaṅkhyāgaṇayutairaṣṭabhiḥ sevito'niśam kālameghanibhāḥ sarpabhūṣaṇāḥ kṛttivāsasaḥ niviśya te nimeṣeṇa niḥśeṣāñcakrurojasā kecinnakhaiḥ pāṭitāṇgāḥ kecinmuṣṭibhirāhatāḥ evaṃ dṛṣṭvā pranaṣṭāṃ svāmindraśatruścamūṃ ruṣā evaṃ gaṇānardyamānān vīkṣya daityena saṃyuge indraśatruṃ parvatābhaṃ yuyudhuḥ sarpavāhanam vajrasaṃhanaṃ tasya śūladaṇḍaprapātanaiḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā virujaṃ daityaṃ bhairavāṇāṃ bhayaṅkaram yuddhvā ciramutpatantaṃ gadayā hantumambaram yuddhvā surā'rātirapi kālakarṣṇikā'hvyām tacchaktigaṇaniḥśeṣīkṛtadaityamahāgaṇaḥ svapneśyā yuyudhe daityo mahākukṣirvṛkāśrayaḥ ciraṃ yodhayatastasya mahākukṣerbalīyasaḥ madoddhato'pi baṭukabhairave' susaṅgataḥ mahākapāladaṇdāḍhyaiḥ sarpabhūṣaṇasaṃyutaiḥ tamastomanibhaiścandracūḍairyuktena sarvataḥ baṭukānāṃ gaṇāḥ kruddhā niviśyā'suravāhinīm

atha kruddhaṃ daityapatiṃ nipatantaṃ gadādharam daṇḍā'hatyā dalanmūrdhā vaman raktaṃ saphenilam evaṃ viṣaṅgaḥ putreṣu naṣṭeṣvatyantaduḥkhitaḥ nipapātaikapātena pralayā'nilavajjavāt śastradhārāṃ vimuñcan vai kurvan satimirā diśaḥ atha jambhinimukhyābhirnāśitā kṣaṇamātrataḥ kecittriśūlasphuṭitahṛdayā jīvitaṃ jahuḥ apare sāyakaiśchannā tato'nye muṣṭidāritāḥ kecicchastraughasampātaśakalīkṛtadehakāḥ nihatya gadyā śaktisenāṃ bhittvā hyaśeṣataḥ gadayaiva hi santāḍay ratharājaṃ samāruhat śaktisenāsu samabhūddhāhā'kāramahādhvanīḥ caturthaparvā'ntarālaṃ prāviśat satvaraṃ balī avaruhya yuyodhoścairmusalena svaparvataḥ śastrairvicitrairastraiśca sarvalokabhayaṅkaram māyāṃ prāduścākāroccaiḥ sarvalokabhayāvaham agnivarṣaṃ raktā'medhyādivarṣaṇam sahasrapādabāhvāsyamātmānaṃ śatadhā'pi ca bhītāḥ śaktiḥ samālokya daṇḍinī śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ māyāṃ sasarja mahatīṃ dadṛśuḥ sarvaśaktyaḥ svayaṃ vāhānnihatyā'śu rathaṃ chittvā'pyanekadhā cukruśurmāyayā tasya hāhetyuścaistu śaktyaḥ alaṃ daityeṣu te devi līlayā bhītidānayā nirmāyā'streṇa daiteyaṃ vimāyaṃ nāśaya drutam rathaneturvacaḥ śrutvā matvā yuktañca daṇḍinī

vāyuneva ca nīhāro naṣṭā māyā ca sarvataḥ dṛṣṭvaiva taṃ daṇḍinī sākruddhā khaḍgena tacchiraḥ evaṃ tasmin vinihate viṣaṅge bhīmavikrame diśo vitimirā jātāḥ suprabhaśca divākaraḥ viṣaṅgavadhavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ muditāḥ śaktyaḥ sarvāstuṣṭuvurdaṇḍanāyikām śokakātaratāṃ prāpa moheneṣanmahāsuraḥ aho māṃ kiṃ vadāmīha śocantaṃ muktabhāvataḥ evaṃ sā pūrayeccheṣamāśu nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ vilambena mamā'trā'laṃ śreyo vighnairhi saṅkulam diśatyeva parāmbā sā bhāvarūpā hi kāmadhuk paramānandajananīṃ hitvā daivahato janaḥ nīyate vyarthamaniśaṃ mṛtyorbhakṣyopasekatām samīkṣan kaśmalamamuṃ vimucya hatadehakam iti sañcintya daityendraḥ svāntarasyā'bhiguptaye ni'hśeṣām tarasā yuktastayā yuddhāya daṃśitaḥ śvetamuktā'tapatreṇa vījyamānaśca cāmaraiḥ nadadvāditravipulairāsphoṭā'ravabṛṃhitaiḥ rathavāhanasihānāṃ gartjitaiḥ pūrayan jagat athā'pa"yacchaktisenā bhaṇḍasenāmahārṇavam tatra mantramahārājñīṃ bhaṇḍaṃ yuddhāya saṅgatam devi bhaṇḍaḥ svayaṃ prāpto yoddhumatyantasaṃyutaḥ jaitrayātrā bhavatyāśca yuktā'tra yadi manyase athā'bhavacchaktisenā sannaddhā nimiṣā'rddhataḥ gajā'nīkasvāminī sā tatpaścāt sampadīśvarī

tadanu pracacālā'jā cakrarājamahārathaḥ muktācchatramahonnamraḥ padmaketudhvajocchrayaḥ vāhayantī taṃ rathendraṃ mahātripurasundarī cakrarājaśatā'ṅgasya vāmadakṣiṇabhāgayoḥ daṇḍinīmantriṇībhyāṃ tau daṃśitābhyāmadhiṣṭhitau tiraskṛtiścakrarājarathapṛṣṭhaṃ samāśritā utkhātavelladatyantakarālakaravālinī evaṃ śrīlalitādevī senayā saha niryayau senayorubhayoraśvarathebhapadacāriṇām janayadgāḍhatimiraṃ dārśanaiśamiva mahī vā sainyamarditā tathā rajomahāsaṃghavegodrdhvagatihetutaḥ ityādi tarkamāpannā vaimānikagaṇāstadā nadatsu yuddhavādyeṣu yukteṣvāsphoṭagarjanaiḥ gadācakrabhindipālaparighāṅkuśayaṣṭibhiḥ hatāḥ smaḥ sarvathā'smākaṃ śokaḥ putrādināśataḥ vikramya yudhi jitvemāḥ śaktiḥ prāpsyām āśiṣam iti niścitya te daittyā yuyudhurbalavattaram hatvā jayaṃ paramakaṃ prāpsyāmo'dyaiva sarvathā evaṃ niyudhyamāneṣu śaktibhirditijeṣvatha decijjālīkṛtā'ṅgāstu śarajālairgatā'savaḥ keṣāñcit khaḍgaghātena śiraścaṭiti cotpatat peṣitā mudgarāghātaiścakrarmadhye vidāritā ḥ śaraiḥ śirāṃsi kṛttāni gagane yānti vegataḥ vikīrṇāṅgaiścitā yuddhe bhūmirviruruce tadā asṛgvahā vavau tatra citrakārapramādataḥ

citrakāreṇa jhaṭiti pramṛṣṭa iva bhāṣate samagralikhitānīva citrā.i dadṛśurnanu nanāśā'sadya śaktīnāṃ senāgniṃ śalabho yathā śaktisenāṃ śastravarṣairarddayāmāsuruścakaiḥ mantriṇī daṇḍinī cā'śvāruḍhā sampadadhīśvarī tā yudhdhvā suciraṃ daityaiḥ sinādhīśairmahābalaiḥ vakrākṣaṃ vāmanaṃ tālaṃ dīrghanasaṃ (ghoṇaṃ?) subāhukam sampatkarī tālajaṅghaṃ kuṭilākṣaṃ raṇoddhatam jambhanī krūravadanaṃ stambhinī sucikāmukham kālakeyaṃ bhairavo'pi vyāghrāsyaṃ kālakarṣiṇī umlukaṃ karabhā'syañca mahākukṣiṃ śivāravam gṛghravāhaṃ kākamukhaṃ daṇḍinī nāśayadyudhi sāhityaśayāmalā ceti nikumbhaṃ kumbhamastakam kaṭaṅkaṭaṃ karañjā'kṣaṃ muṇḍaṃ caṇḍaṃ kṛkā'nanam vakrakukṣiṃ vāmamukhaṃ kālakaṃ koṭaraṃ viṭam evaṃ niḥśeṣataḥ senāsenapeṣu hateṣvatha rathaṃ prāpaya me śīghraṃ sārathe śaktivāhinīm śrutvā vākyaṃ daityapatervāhayan rathamāśu saḥ daityeśvara ! tvayā'jñptaḥ kiñcitpraṣṭuṃ samīhitam iti pṛṣṭena cājñapto prāha daityena sārathiḥ viśukrādyā yayā yuddhe hatā līlāvilāsataḥ hṛṣṭā'ntaram śokaleśā'spṛṣṭaṃ pravrajitaṃ yathā bhaktirdevyāmatitarāṃ tanme brūhi yathātatham na śokaṃ nā'pi bhītiṃ vā lakṣaye tava leśataḥ prāha bhaṇḍaḥ smayan kiñcitcchṛṇu daityetyupākraman

etayā nihato yuddhe prāpsyāmyatyuttamam phalam emaṃ lokaṃ saśokaṃ vai sabhayaṃ duḥkhamātrakam tatrā'pyāsuraloko vai rājaso'tibhayaṅkaraḥ ahaṃ śrīpadmasaṃsthāno dūto māṇikyaśekharaḥ tathā'pi kṛpayā devyā māṃ smṛtirno jahāti vai etayā nihatā yuddhe bhrātaro me sutā api mayā saha tvamapyāśu tallokaṃ prāpya bhrātṛbhiḥ iti śrutvā bhaṇḍavaco viṣmito'bhūt sasārathiḥ dṛṣṭvā śrīlalitāmagre namaścakre subhaktitaḥ śrīdevībhaktirahasyaprakaṭanaṃ nāmaṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ mantriṇīñca samāsādya yuddhakauśalamulvaṇam devyo vo yuddhacāturyavikramaistoṣito'smyaham sarvāstayā me yuddhakarmaṇi tasyā padaṃ vinirjitya yuddhe vo'bhijayamyanu niśamya devyo matvā cā'jeyaṃ svīyaparākramaiḥ dadurmārgaṃ niyuddhāya mahārājñyā'surasya via samārabhadbhaṇḍadaityo yuddhamatyadbhūtaṃ tadā vaimānikairdevagaṇaiḥ siddhairṝṣigaṇaistathā bhaṇḍa āsādya lalitāṃ puro dṛṣṭvā'tiharṣitaḥ vivyādha pañcabhirbāṇaistadadbhutamivā'bhavat tṛtīyaṃ kaṇṭhadeśe'bhūnmālikā phullapāṅkajī antyaṃ ratnamayaṃ mūrghni bhūṣaṇaṃ mukuṭe sthitam devādayo'pi taddṛṣṭvā śaṅkitāstatra sarvathā deveśo'titarāṃ tatra viṣmayaṃ samapadyata citraśastrāstranicayavyāptā'kāśamahodaram

santoṣayitumudyukto yuyodha paramā'stravit gūḍhā'padānavacanairadhikṣeptuṃ pracakrame mṛṣā'cāraratā nityaṃ straiṇaṃ puruṣamāsritā na striyaṃ manye na pumāṃsamapi kvacit na tvaṃ satkulasambhūtā kulahīneva bhāsi me api tvamabhimṛṣṭā'si sarvatheti vibhāsi me anarhāṃ darśane nūnaṃ paśyāmi purataḥ sthitām maddṛṣṭigocarībhūtā samprati tvaṃ kathañcana āsāditā mayā sadyaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ na pradarśaya śakyaṃ hyadṛśyatāṃ yātuṃ tasmāttvaṃ susthirībhava dṛṣṭvā madīyavīryañca saṃsādhaya nijaṃ vratam śṛṇu daityeśvara vaco yaduktaṃ te tathaiva tat na hi me dṛṣṭiviṣayībhūya bhūyo bhavet kvacit ityuktvā śaravarṣeṇa vavarṣa daityabhūpatim śastraprayogavijñānasaṃślāhanapuraḥsaram evaṃ niyudhya suciraṃ daityo'strāṇi sasarja ha pārjanyamaindraṃ vāyavyaṃbrāhmaṃ kaumārameva ca pratyastrairnāśayāmāsa tuhinaṃ dinakṛdyathā sasarjā'tha bhaṇḍadaityo madhuṃ kaiṭabhameva ca balimarjunanāmānaṃ haihayaṃ rāvaṇaṃ tathā evamādīn viṣṇuśatrūn sarvān lokapraṇāśanān udyuktā lokanāśārthaṃ tamovṛttiparāyaṇāḥ nārāyaṇā'vatārāṇāṃ sasarja daśak'm tadā atha bhūyo'ndhakaṃ mṛtyūṃ kāmaṃ tripurameva ca tān dṛṣṭvā śrīparā devī phālanetrādvisarjayat

atha daityamahāsenāmasaṅkhyātāṃ bhayāvahām viṣaṅgaśca viśukraśca caturbāhumukhāḥ sutāḥ atha te yuyudhuḥ śaktisenābhiratimaṣitāḥ bhītāścā'tha kiṃ bhavedai iti devāśca śaktyaḥ hataṃ hataṃ tatra daityo bhūyo bhūyaḥ sasarja ha tadā śrīlalitādevīṃ tuṣṭuvurvidhimukhyakāḥ kṛtāñjalirmadhurayā prārthayāmāsa vai girā paśya śaktigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ śuṣyadvaktraṃ samākulam hataṃ hataṃ śaktigaṇairbhūyaḥ sṛjati vaikṣaṇāt kumāryā saptakṛtvaste bhūyo yudhyanti samprati hataḥ punaḥ sṛṣṭa eva bhaṇḍadaityena yudhyati yudhyantyeva punaḥ sṛṣṭā netaḥ sādhyamidaṃ hi naḥ rakṣa sarvaṃ lokamimaṃ nopekṣāṃ kartumarhasi mā bhaiḥ paśya kṣaṇeṇaiva nāśayāmyasureśvaram tatrā'vāhya pāśupatamastraṃ lokabhayaṅkaram bhasmīcakāra daityānāṃ senāṃ sāgarasammitām tadā diśo'bhito jvālāmālālīḍhābhavan kṣaṇāt carācaraṃ jagajjālaṃ peturulkāḥ sahasraśaḥ tāvaddṛṣṭvā vinaṣṭāṃ svāṃ senāṃ sāgarasannibhām dhyeyamātrātmatāṃ yāvat prāpto bhaṇḍamahāsuraḥ śaraṃ mumoca bhaṇḍāya sa śaro'tibhayaṅkaraḥ carācaraṃ jagajjālaṃ dahanniva nimeṣataḥ bhaṇḍāsurañca sarathaṃ nagaraṃ tasya śūnyakam bhasmaśeṣīkarottatra tadadbhutamivā'bhavat nagaram vā prahatasya daityārbhakamapi kvacit

abhijaghnuḥ śaktigaṇā viāditrāṇi sahasraśaḥ lāsyaṃ cakrurdevavārā urvaśyādyāḥ suharṣitāḥ dadhyurmunigaṇā rūpaṃ praṇemuritare janāḥ balāhakāḥ saumyarūpā garjanto'tyantamantharam mārutāḥ saugandhyayuto vavurānandanaspṛśaḥ sanmanāṃsīva toyāni samāsan saridādiṣu nirākulamasaṅkīrṇaṃ tadā bhaṇḍā'sure hate devā maharṣayaḥ siddhāḥ sarve devīmupāyayuḥ bhaṇḍāsuravadhavarṇanaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ harṣanirbharitasvāntāstuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stavaḥ saṃśritebhyo'tiśīghram vyomamārgāḥ bhavatu satatamasmanmānase nīrajaske viśadavikacavṛttau vāsite vāsanābhiḥ bhūyo bhūyo'pi vividhaiḥ stavaistuṣṭuvurambikām ājagmurbhāratīmukhyaśaktiyuktā ghaṭodbhava ! samīḍalalitāmīḍyāṃ prāhubarddhakarā'mbujāḥ brahmāṇḍānāṃ śataṃ pañca caiṣāṃ sa hyadhipo'bhavat lokā'dhipatyaṃ sarvatra daityaireva cakāra saḥ na kvaciddaivayajño vā brahmayajño'pi śaṅkari ! tadadya nihate daitye tvayā yudhi maheśvari svasvā'dhikārakṛtyeṣu jātaṃ sarvaṃ nirākulam devīṃ vidhimukhāṃścā'pi praṇamya racitā'ñjaliḥ devyāḥ śrīpuranirmāṇe tattathā racitaṃ mayā evaṃ tvaṣṭrā prārthito'jo devyai vṛttaṃ vyajijñapat śaktisenā devagaṇairyutā tatra yayau drutam

mahāśrīpurarājasya pratibimbavivārpitam atha tatra nivasane devāḥ śrīlalitāmbikām tatsammatiṃ samādāya buddhīśapramukhāstadā prakalpya sarbasambhārān śubhalagnamuhūrtake cakārā'gamadṛṣṭena mārgeṇottamakalpataḥ gandhrvā devadūtāśca dikpālā yakṣaguhyakāḥ vidyāghrāḥ siddhamunaya ṛṣayaḥ pitaro'surāḥ sadāśiveśvarau cā'pi śrīkaṇṭho'nanta eva ca paricerustatra devīṃ lalitā'mbāṃ samantataḥ pṛthagabhūtaiḥ pūjayāmāsurādarāt nadatsu śubhavādyeṣu mūrcchayatsu sumūrcchānām gandharveṣu pranṛtyatsu devaveśyāsu sarvataḥ stuvatsu vividheṣūccaiḥ prekṣatsu prāṇiṣūdyamaiḥ atha mantraprapūtā'dbhirnavaratnavicitritaiḥ abhyaṣiñcallokadhātā vaśiṣṭhapramudhairvṛtaḥ vicitradivyavasanāṃ śrīcakrā'dhivirājitām pūjayāmāsuramarā vividhaiḥ susamarhaṇaiḥ stutvā vicitrastavanaiḥ praṇemurbhuvi daṇḍavat siṃhāsane'bhiṣiktā sā mahāśrīpuravattadā evaṃ ghaṭodbhava mune ! meruśṛṅge mahonnate devaśilpisvacāturyasarvasāravinirmitam prārthitā vidhimukhyaiḥ sā svīkṛtya karuṇāvaśāt iti śrutvā hayagrīvāt kathāṃ paramapāvanīm hayagrīva dayāsindho ! merāvasmin tvayoditam na me hyaviditaṃ sthānaṃ brahmāṇḍāntarbhavet kvacit

merumūrghni brahmaviṣṇuśivadhāmāni santi vai tat kathaṃ varṇitaṃ tatra śrīpuraṃ me samīraya śṛṇu kumbhajaḥ ! vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ hyetaduttamam ye tu śrītripurāṃ śaktiṃ vidhinā samupāsate tatte māhātmyasaṃśrutyā bhaktirhṛdi samudgatā prāpte ratnākare yadvadbhavenno ratnavāñcitā tasyā dīkṣāṃ samādāya copāsya vidhivatparām etatte kumbhaja ! proktaṃ lalitāyā mahādbhutam kalau malīmasahṛdāṃ janānāṃ durdhiyāmidam vaidikaiḥ karmabhirbhūyo nirāśīrbhiḥ kṛtairvavet viṣṇau śive śaktiṣu ca sarvānte paripākataḥ etadārādhanenaiva viditvā svā'tmarūpīm abhivyaktaparaiśvaryo na punarbhavamṛcchati śravaṇaṃ śrīparāśaktimāhātmyavibhavonnateḥ etat pāpapraśamanaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalāvaham ityuktvā kumbhajamunipūjito'śvānano bhṛśam iti te kathitā rāma lalitāyāḥ kathā śubhā śrīlalitābhiṣekavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ jamadagnisutaḥ śrutvā harṣā'mṛtāniṣecitaḥ nirantarasravaddharṣanetravāripariplutaḥ babhāṣe gadgadaśrutyā bhūyo viracitā'ñjaliḥ parākathātīrthavāridhārānivahasecanaiḥ namaste śrīguro nātha duḥkhadhvāntadinādhipa ! yo me mārga niradiśadandhasya bhramato yathā śūnyakūpe bheka iva na svārthamavidaṃ kvacit

mokṣalakṣmīmabhiprepsurabhavaṃ sarvathā nanu tat pṛcchāmi bhavantaṃ yadvaktuṃj tanme samarhasi nā'vaktvyaṃ mayi bhavecchiṣye kāruṇikasya te nopāsīttaṃ parāśaktiṃ sarvalokamaheśvarīm kuto va vedanirate na hi syāttasya darśanam ityāpṛṣṭo jāmadagnyaṃ prāha dattagururmuniḥ na hyatra kevalaṃ śāstraṃ prayojakamupeyate vāsanānāṃ śataṃ citte sañcitaṃ prāṇināṃ pṛthak yāvadyatsaṅgamāpnoti tāvat tat syānna cā'nyathā sañjātatripurābhaktiḥ patnyā dīkṣāṃ samādade na tāvanmokṣasaudhasya sopānā'rohaṇakṣamaḥ na yogyatā tathā'trāpi vinā dīkṣāṃ bhṛgūdbaha svabuddhyā tu kṛtaṃ karma vidhinā ca samanvitam sevitāraṃ yathā hanti cā'pakvantu rasāyanam yaḥ samāsādayet sa hi devatādrohamāpnuyāt ajño drohakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ nāśayenmānavaḥ katham yojayantyeva bhūpālā mahādaṇḍaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ vedavādaireva na hi bhavedatrā'dhikāritā puruṣārtho vedavidhau sarvathā na hi vidyate aṇumātrā'tmabhūtānāṃ puruṣārthā'bhimāninām vaidikā hyacalammanyāḥ phalaṃ dhūmasamudbhavam miteṣu duḥkhabhūteṣu phaleṣu sukhabuddhayaḥ pravartito guṇamayo vedo dhātrā jagatkṛtiḥ martukāmasya viṣavat kāmināṃ kāmanāmayaḥ dhātraiva gopanāttasya guptabhāveṣu mohitāḥ

jīveṣu dayayā samyak cittā'rohopayogyayā ato'tra tyaktakāmānāmadhikāro vidhīyate ajñānāmnohato vā'pi vidyopāstiṃ tyajettu yaḥ sannyāsinā tu tyaktavyaṃ sarvaṃ bandhātmanā sthitam na (hi) tyaktuṃ samucitaṃ brāhmaṇyamiva vai yateḥ tāmisramandhatāmisraṃ kumbhīpākamavīcikam daṇḍarājñyā samājñaptāḥ śaktyo'tivibhīṣaṇāḥ upāstimārgasarujānaparādhaparān janān upāsanaparo martyaḥ kaivalyaṃ padamaśnute vaidikopāsakasyaiṣā sarvathā na hi vidyate anīśvaraṃ pauruṣaṃ syādataḥ paśuphalocitam mocayatyāśu saṃsiddhyā śraddhābhaktisubṛṃhitam prāpyate'traiva śivatā prabuddhaiḥ pauruṣeṇa hi nā'dhikāro vinā dīkṣāṃ karmaṇi jñānasādhane sadāśivena te samyak prabuddhāḥ śivarupiṇaḥ tasmānna vedaśāstrādyaiḥ śuṣkaiḥ sadgatirāpyate na sādhanaṃ phalaṃ vā'pi pravṛttirvā.pi bhārgava ! ārādhya śivaviṣṇavādīnapi yat prāpyate phalam pūjanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ parāśakteḥ prapūjanam tasmāt pūjā tu śakteḥ syāt sarvatra vihitā janaiḥ pūjayanti pṛthak devaṃ phalaṃ vindanti tattathā āśrayatvācchivamṛte śaktirnaiva tu vidyate prakāśaśaktihīno vai raviḥ kutra kadā bhāvet citiśaktyā parityaktaṃ tṛṇaṃ vā'pi kathaṃ bhavet yadasti taścitiriti jānīhi bhṛgunandana

evaṃ buddhyā tu yat kiñcit tṛṇañca tripurātmakam tasmāttyajā'tra sandehametatsarvatra vai samam nirviśeṣantu tadrūpamakhaṇḍaikacidātmakam vedā viśeṣabahulā gūhayantyaviśeṣakam vedārthaḥparamo yastu tripuraiva hi sā bhavet vedārthasyaiva vyasanaṃ purāṇaṃ vyāsa ūcivān tasyā mūrttirataḥ sarvaṃ pravṛttaṃ saṃśrayāt dayayā parameśānaḥ sarvānuddhartumicchayā āgamaḥ parameśasya vimarśa iti niścayaḥ apāro hyāgamā'mbhodhiḥ sarvalokeṣu saṅgataḥ ṛṣibhistamāgamābdhiṃ mathitvā prājyayā dhiyā deśabhedavibhedena pṛthageva vibhāvitam śrautakarmamukhenaiva tāntrike hyadhikāritā veda eva hi tantraṃ syāttantraṃ vedaḥ prakīrtitam tathā hi vedabhāgeṣu tantrabhāgaḥ pradṛśyate evaṃvidho vedabhāgo yatastanmūrghni saṃsthitaḥ tantreṣvapi vedabhāgā mantrabrāhmaṇabheditāḥ evaṃ purāṇādiṣu ca tantrabhāgaḥ pradṛśyate sa purāṇaprabhāgaḥ syādevaṃ jānīhi bhārgava ! āgamābdhistato vedāṃstantrāṇi ca vibhāvaya ato'gastyastantradīkṣārahito vaidiko'pi san atha śrutvā mahādevyā māhātmyaṃ sarbato'dhikam patnyā upāsya tripurāṃ tatra śrīnāthamaṇḍalo evaṃ tena samākrāntaṃ dṛṣṭañca sthānamuttamam nāmaikonā'śītitamo'dhyāyaḥ

bhūyaḥ prāha prasannātmā praṇamya racitā'ñjaliḥ abhavaṃ muktasandehaḥ kiñcit pṛcchāmi vai punaḥ kurvannityakriyāṃ kena viśeṣeṇa hi karmaṇā tanme samācakṣva guro kṛpayā mayi sevake śṛṇu rāma mahāguhyaṃ tripurāprītikārakam naivedaistu gaṇeśāno'laṅkārāddharireva ca parāśaktirmaheśānī tatra sarvottamaṃ śṛṇu tatra śrīcakrarājaṃ vā mūrtiṃ vā'pi sulakṣaṇām pūjayet pañcakālaṃ vā catustrirdvyekakālakam nityaṃ vā dvitryekakālaṃ pañcakālañca parvasu rathena vāhanairyānairutsavapratimāṃ bahiḥ evaṃ yaḥ kurute loke sa vasecchrīpurā'ntare asamartho'nyavihite sthāpayeścakranāyakam na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ sāyujyaṃ vindate kramāt yatra syāt sthāvaraṃ yantraṃ nivasaṃstatsamīpataḥ upāsakastu jānīyāttatkṣetraṃ sarvato'dhikam pūjayet sthāvaraṃ ckraṃ mūrtiṃ vā bhaktipūrvakam phalaṃ samāvahellakṣaguṇaṃ rāma ! na saṃśayaḥ tatttsthāne bhāvayan vai mahāphalasamāptaye sūryā'tmabhūtāstasyāṃ'sāḥ sarvalokaprasādakāḥ tripurāyāḥ parāśakteḥ parivārākhyadevatāḥ tasyāṃ'śabhūtāḥ sarvā vai tasmāt pūjyā yathāvidhī tathaiva'vṛtiśaktīnāmaikyātmā tripurā matā yathākathañcidvā pūjyā sthāvare parameśvarī tamātmaghnaṃ vijānīyāt sarvalokavininditam

dakṣiṇātāmbūladīpapraṇāmaparivartanaiḥ ? sahasrādyairnāmabhistu yaścakrādau prapūjayet mucyate nā'sti sandeha ityāha bhagavān śivaḥ viśeṣaparvasu tathā śukravāre'pi vā'rabhet tataḥ sampūjya vidhinā cā'vṛtyantaṃ maheśvarīm tatra puṣpopacārasya sthāne pūjāṃ samācaret samāpayedyathāvatta pratyahañcaivamarcayet ekajātīyakaiḥ puṣpaiḥ yatraiva pūjayet parām ante tu sarvatobhadre navayonisamāyute alaṅkṛtaṃ sūtravastrairmadhye taṇdulapuñjake tamaṣṭagandhatoyena pūrayet pañcaratnakam sataṇḍulaṃ phalaṃ pūrṇa pātrañcā'pi mukhe nyaset vinyasya tasyāmāvāhya pūjanantu samācaret daśadikṣu ca dikpālān śṛṅkhalāsu caturṣu ca raktār'dhabhavane pūrvāt prādakṣiṇyena pūjayet evaṃ sampūjya kalaśe pīṭhapūjanapūrvakam tattatpuṣ.pādikaṃ svarṇabhavaṃ vā rajatodbhavam tadardha pādamapi vā kṛtvā tannavasaṅkhyakam madhye ca tripurāṃ rātrau pūjayeścakranāyakam svayaṃ vā pūjayedācāryeṇa vā kramavedinā guruṃ suvāsinīñcāpi brāhmaṇādīnapi kramāt kathābhirgāyanairnṛtyaiḥ kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ niśi pūjāṅgahomataḥ paścādagniṃ saṃsādhya śāstrataḥ pūjāṃ samāpya coddhāsya kalaśaṃ vastrasaṃyutam brāhmaṇānāṃ ṣoḍaṣakaṃ suvāsinyaṣṭakaṃ tathā

bhojayedbhakṣyabhojyādyairdakṣiṇādyaiśca toṣayet prasannā tripureśānī vāñchitārthapradā bhavet pitṝproddharate sarvanante mokṣaṃ samaśnute japāpuṣ.paiḥ santatiṃ vai jātīpuṣ.pairgṛhādikam kiṃśukairoganihatiṃ kuṭajaiḥ śatrunāśanam pūjayitvā vidhānena mahāphalamavāpnuyāt lakṣavartipradīpairvā pūjayettripurā'mbikām daśakena śatenā'pi sahastreṇā'pi vā tathā ekaikañca ghṛtā'pūrṇamarpayedekanāmabhiḥ daśā'vartanakairvāpi caikāvartanakena vā ante svarṇena raupyeṇa navakaṃ varttiyugmakam nivedayettu kalaśe pāyasena hunettathā āvṛttīnāṃ lakṣakena sahasreṇa śatena vā madhubhirvā phalarasairdadhibhirvā sugandhibhiḥ ante daśāṃ'śato banhau pāyasena hūnet kramāt rudrābhiṣekato vā'pi mahāphalamudīritam adhanaistu śarīreṇa kartavyaṃ śubhasādhanam atha vā devatāsthāne paricaryāṃ samācare tu atimūḍhasya caitāvadeva kṛtyamudīritam devatāśāstrapaṭhanāt pāṭhanācchreya āpnuyāt sa dehānte vaidrume tu prākāre nivaseściram nivasedvāsantavapre ciramānanditā'ntaraḥ abhirṣañcettathā śītatoyairapi suvāsitaiḥ yastu rātrau dīpikābhiḥ prakāśayati mandiram evamatra yathā yo yaḥ sevāṃ kuryāttu mandire

upāsakebhyo dānāni kṛtvā'pi sthānamāpnuyāt sa vaseddikpatīnāṃ hi vapre saukhyamavāpnuyāt tattattulyanivasatiṃ prāpnuyānnā'tra saṃśayaḥ śrīckrājadānantu mahāphalavidhāyakam pūjānte tripurāpūjāparaṃ vipraṃ sulakṣaṇam vastrairābharaṇaiḥ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt sāmānyā'rghodakaṃ haste viprasya samavāsṛjet bhojayedāvṛtimitān brāhmaṇān suvidhānataḥh yathāśaktyā vā'pi viprān bhojayettu prayatnataḥ ṣoḍaśa brahmaṇāṃścāpi dvādaśā'rādhya bhojayet tasya prītā mahādevī svasāyujyaṃ prayacchati sarvaṃ dānaṃ tena dattaṃ tena yajñāstathā kṛtāḥ tripurā'pi ca tatkarmasakṛśaṃ nā'sti vai phalam yataḥ sarvajagadrūpapratimaṃ rāma cakrakam yadi kāmanayā kuryādyaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhīpsati evantu sthāvaraṃ yantramagre hārasamanvitam tasya puṇyamananto'pi na śaktaḥ kathane kvacit śāligrāmaṃ kuṇḍalinīmeva dadyāttu bhaktitaḥ mandiraṃ cakrarājāderjīrṇaṃ kuryānnavantu yaḥ pūjāṃ vā'pi cirocchinnāṃ pravartayati yaḥ punaḥ sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi bhārgava ! dhanamānādyapekṣaḥ san kramadīkṣādirītitaḥ yathecchaṃ nivasennāthamaṇḍale'nte vimucyate kāmānmohāt pramādādvā vairāgyādvā niṣedhati tayorna vidyate lokaḥ prāpsyato hyadhamāṅgatim

vidyālobhayuto maurkhyāt so'pi yātyadhamāṃ gatim sampradāyaṃ vijijñāsuṃ na niśidhyet kathañcana anyaddānamanātmākhyamapi bandhakaram bhavet vidyālikhitadānena cā'pi tatphalam syādanantakam vidyālikhitadānena cā'pi tatphalamāpnuyāt evaṃ mahāphalaprāptistripuropāsanāvidhau māhātmyavaibhavo yasya śravaṇādbhaktimān bhavet eṣa māhātmyakhaṇḍo vai tripurāyā rahasyake paramaṃ sādhanaṃ hyetadātmabandhavimuktaye sā māhātmayaśrutimṛte yato na bhavati kvacit māhatmyaśravaṇaṃ loke mokṣadvāramidaṃ smṛtam bhakyā vinā paraṃ śreyaḥ kathaṃ syāddevatā parā yathā taruṇyāḥ saundarya vinasaṃsarvathā tathā tathā bhaktiṃ vinā jñānaṃ phalaṃ na janayet kvacit tasmādbhaktivihīnasya na kvacit syād dhṛtiḥ kvacit tasmādetaṃ saṃśṛṇuyāt khaṇḍaṃ māhātmyasaṃjñitam paṭhitavyaṃ nityametadadhyāyaṃ ślokameva vā etadāyuṣyajananaṃ saumaṅgalyavivardhanam yadyatsamīhitaṃ tattatprāpyate'sya hi saṃśruteḥ vicāritaṃ jñānabhaktivairāgyādipradaṃ nṛnām amṛtāḥ śivamukhyāḥ syuḥ sā mātā tripuraiva hṛīm upāsakamukhyadharmavarṇanaṃ nāmā'śītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
